article_title: 10 Father’s Day Gifts at Tecovas, From Bestselling Boots to Elevated Basics

article_content: When searching for the perfect gift, it's easy to overthink — especially for Father's Day . The best advice is to keep your criteria simple. Look for something high quality that will hold up for years to come — bonus points if it's something that they might not necessarily think to buy for themselves. A new handmade leather belt or a classic pair of luxury cowboy boots are intentionally made to maintain their premium quality over time. And that is the definition of a gift that keeps on giving! Whether you want to fully lean into the western aesthetic or look for everyday leather items, we found the best Father's day gifts to shop at Tecovas. Ahead, find our 10 favorites, from cowboy hats and boots to premium travel cases. Tecovas Men's Performance Western Short Sleeve Pearl Snap ($85) This performance shirt is made to wick away moisture, stand up to wrinkles, and has a UPF50++ rating for extra sun protection. With 10 different colors to choose from, consider this style the perfect elevated basic for any dad who spends lots of time outdoors. Tecovas Men's Dobby Camp Shirt ($95) If a traditional T-shirt feels too casual, a short sleeve button-down will add an extra level of sophistication. This breathable cotton fabric holds up to summer heat and can be worn alone or over an undershirt as a light layer. Tecovas Men's Denim Long Sleeve Pearl Snap ($95) What makes this button-down stand out from other brands is in the details. The curved western stitching and the pearl snap buttons instantly elevate the 100 percent denim top. It can easily be styled with jeans for a denim-on-denim look or with a summer trouser for a more neutral outfit. Tecovas Men's Goat Belt ($95) There is nothing more timeless than a leather belt. This design is handmade in Mexico and includes an antique brass buckle. The band is just over an inch thick, making it versatile for any outfit or occasion. Tecovas Bartlett Travel Kit ($125) Level up your dad's toiletry bag. The main compartment is spacious enough to fit shaving and grooming essentials with a hidden interior zipper to maximize organization. Plus, the external handle makes it easy to grab on the go. Tecovas Cattleman Straw Cowboy Hat ($145) Not only will this hat's four-inch brim protect the face and neck from the sun, but the ventilated crown will allow for maximum air flow. Plus, the neutral straw material acts as the perfect summer color. Tecovas The Monterrey Penny Slip Ons ($225) Every dad needs a loafer. Whether he likes to wear them to the office, a fancy dinner, or a summer vacation, these premium suede slip-ons will stand the test of time. Tecovas The Dean Cowboy Boots ($295) As a slightly modern take on the traditional cowboy boot, The Dean is ideal for tucking under pants. The short shaft and side zipper allow for a slightly more fitted finish, while still delivering a western flair. Tecovas The Doc Cowboy Boots ($375) This bestseller is designed to be a little dressier than your average cowboy boot. The square-toe style comes in eight different colorways, from classic black and brown to elaborate patchwork. Tecovas The Cartwright Cowboy Boots ($375) The Cartwright is Tecovas's original cowboy boot and includes all the traditional details. article_title: Keke Palmer Wowed in a Metallic Corset at Essence Festival — Get Her Look Starting at $14
sub_title: See the best celebrity outfits at Essence Festival, from Keke Palmer's metallic corset to Teyana Taylor's floral gown.
article_content: Every year, Essence Festival brings out some of the biggest names in entertainment to the great city of New Orleans for a weekend celebrating Black music, culture, and revelry. Hosted near the July 4 holiday, the landmark event boasts nightly concerts at the Superdome — including Prince in 2014, Janet Jackson in 2022, and Usher in 2024 — as well as a packed schedule of events during the day like the "Black Excellence" brunch and Prime Video "Essence of Leading Ladies" soiree. And celebrities come dressed in their finest summer-ready outfits for the occasion. Keeping the city's scorching temperatures and soaring humidity in mind, stars manage to choose practical looks without sacrificing style. There are plenty of warm-weather-friendly trends on display, from cutouts to micro minis. Embellished one-shoulder dresses, polished skirt suits, and colorful rompers are also in heavy demand at the stylish festival. For concerts, artists think outside the box, choosing bold designs that will make a memorable impact. From a studded bra-and-chaps set to a nude bodysuit covered in glittering gold embellishment, there's no telling what theatrical look you'll witness on the Essence Festival stage. For the 2026 Essence Festival, artists brought their sartorial A-game. Keke Palmer graced the stage to host a live version of her podcast in a gorgeous metallic corset. Brandy looked stunning for her headlining concert at the Superdome wearing a black and white printed Christian Siriano gown. Teyana Taylor wowed at Essence Black Women in Hollywood wearing a printed floral gown that would work perfectly for a summer garden wedding. Shop pieces inspired by Palmer's look below, and keep scrolling for the best celebrity looks from the 2026 Essence Festival (and years prior), from the stage to the red carpet. article_title: Shop J Lo's Wedding Guest Look For Taylor and Travis's Wedding — Starting at $70
sub_title: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce tied the knot on Friday, July 3 at Madison Square Garden. Here are the celebrity guests who made our best dressed list.
article_content: Congratulations are in order for Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce after they tied the knot on Friday, July 3 at Madison Square Garden. The wedding weekend has been kept under wraps with only one major confirmation so far: a sign outside MSG reading "JUST&T MARRIED!" that appeared after the ceremony. While we patiently wait for more details to be released, all of our attention has turned to the guest list. The star-studded event included Hollywood stars, NFL players, music legends, and, of course, Swift's inner circle. From her childhood best friend Abigail to icons like Jennifer Lopez, there was no shortage of high-fashion moments. Ahead, we found the best wedding guest looks from Swift and Kelce's big day. For an elegant head-to-toe black outfit, Jennifer Lopez wore a drop-waist Bach Mai gown. While the designer was unaware where she would be wearing the dress when her team requested it, he still thought the choice fit the setting. "I think the silhouette and dramatic volume bring a level of formality befitting for such a momentous occasion," he tells Popsugar. "The high-low hemline and subdued color keep it light and appropriate for a wedding guest." She accessorized the look with a Carolina Herrera Karlita Bow Satin Clutch ($1,490) and Jimmy Choo Max 150 Black Satin Sandals ($1,050). Recreate Lopez's look with these similar dress styles: ASTR the Label Vinya Cotton Dress ($70, originally $158), Almond Muse Francesca Dress ($80, originally $160), Alex & Sophia Juniors' Scoop Neck Shirred Midi Dress ($119), L'Academie Sidney Gown ($288), and Jenny Yoo Shelby Dress ($295). Taylor Swift's life-long best friend Abigail Anderson was in her enchanted era for Friday's nuptials. She wore the Sau Lee Frances Corset Gown ($795) with a floral embroidered corset top and effortlessly draped satin skirt. Camila Cabello opted for a bright color with her wedding guest look via the Zimmermann Luna Lace Billow Gown ($1,980, originally $3,300). Thanks to the sheer lace fabric, the bold hue didn't feel overwhelming but rather romantic given the flowy silhouette. Swift's longtime publicist Tree Paine went for a simple yet structured gown. Her Rachel Gilbert Rowana Gown ($1,650) has strategic ruching that lends itself to an hourglass shape. Pretty in pink, Gigi Hadid showed up with a romantic rose dress from Wiederhoeft's Spring/Summer 2025 collection. Paired with a chunky diamond necklace and soft, dreamy glam, we can't help but imagine Hadid was channeling her inner Barbie. The Wiederhoeft team told Popsugar the dress was requested earlier in spring by Hadid's team, but they weren't sure what event it would be worn for — until now. Selena Gomez's Oscar de la Renta gown captured the perfect level of sparkle. Embellished with thousands of beads and rhinestones, the champagne-gold color felt like the definition of a subtle statement. Some Swifties are also noting that Swift wore a gold dress to Gomez's wedding in September 2025, calling out the connection in shade. In a trendy shade of olive green, Kelsea Ballerini wore a structured Alex Perry gown to celebrate, photographed here by Shervin Lainez before the ceremony. While her exact dress isn't available to shop, it is very similar to the Alex Perry Strapless Longline Corset Twist Drape Column Dress ($2,950). For a slightly different take on a gold wedding guest look, Karlie Kloss looked stunning in her strapless satin Tove gown from the fall 2026 collection. Our favorite accessory? Her pop of red lipstick, which might have been a subtle nod to Swift's favorite lip color . Proving that sometimes a spectacular fabric can be the only statement you need, Tate McRae stunned in a metallic vintage Valentino gown sourced from Raffe Vintage. The light bounced off the V-cut top and tiered skirt. To match the unofficially confirmed garden theme, actress Joey King chose a black halter Leo Lin gown with blue and green floral embroidery. We love how the whimsical details add a bit of playfulness to the moment. To celebrate her fellow country star, Miranda Lambert stepped out in a black halter dress. We especially love the lace detailing, which played up the otherwise traditional design for the special occasion. Adelaide Giesey (she/her) is a shopping writer at Popsugar. article_title: The Hottest Item in Fashion This Summer? A Soccer Jersey
sub_title: With the World Cup in full swing, soccer jerseys are everywhere. If you want a social cheat code for the summer, we've got you covered on how to style one.
article_content: Not long ago, soccer jerseys were reserved for game days, stadium seats, and devoted fans. Now, they've become one of fashion's most coveted wardrobe staples. The rise of jersey dressing didn't happen overnight though. Fashion has long borrowed from the world of sports, from varsity jackets and tennis skirts to racing-inspired streetwear . Soccer jerseys, in particular, have been steadily gaining momentum over the past few years thanks to influencers and celebrities like Rihanna, Hailey Bieber, and Dua Lipa. Most recently, Sabrina Carpenter wore an England shirt paired over a mini-dress during a performance and Anne Hathaway wore an Arsenal top to the Devil Wears Prada premier in England. For anyone who tracked the tenniscore and blokecore waves, this one won't come as a surprise. In the last three years, high-fashion brands like Balenciaga , Dior , Stella McCartney , and streetwear brands like adidas have partnered with football teams to design special merch. The streetwear retailer teamed up with designer Yohji Yamamoto to create Japan's 2022 jersey and with Wales Bonner to design Jamaica's 2023 jersey. Further, legacy football clubs have even started hiring in-house creative directors to design new team jerseys. This summer, however, the trend is poised to reach a whole new level thanks to the FIFA World Cup — held in the United States , Mexico, and Canada from June 11 to July 19. In fact, soccer jersey sales have grown fivefold in the last 18 months on live shopping app Tilt . With the world's attention turning to international soccer, jerseys are becoming more than just a fashion statement — they're a symbol of excitement, community, and friendly competition. As fans gather in bars, living rooms, parks, and watch parties around the globe, what you wear won't just show off your style, but reveal where your loyalties lie and your dedication to current events. A soccer jersey can instantly kick off a conversation: Are you supporting the defending champions? Pulling for an underdog nation? Watching every match with friends or hosting your own viewing party? Suddenly, your outfit becomes an invitation to connect with fellow fans. It's fashion with built-in small talk. Part of the appeal of the soccer jersey is its versatility. Whether it's the official team jersey, a clever vintage find from the '90s, iconic club colors, or a newly released national team design — soccer jerseys bring lots of personality and can be styled in multiple ways. They're bold without trying too hard, instantly recognizable, and often spark conversations in a way that few fashion pieces can. And unlike many fashion trends , you don't need a designer budget to participate. Once you have the jersey, you can pull from your closet to style the rest — adding wide-leg trousers, straight-leg jeans, puffy skirts, and more. There really is no single way to wear the look. The beauty of the trend lies in making it your own. Now that the games have begun, get inspired to style your jersey for both at-home and buzzy bar watch parties, or, for the lucky ones, in-person stadium matches. Whether you take your cues from the dressed up or down looks below, it's high time you become a well-styled footy fan. Grab your favorite cowboy boots — we like Tecovas Sadie Vintage ($495) — and lean into western wear with this look. For the rest of the fit you'll need a Mexico 2026 Authentic Home Jersey ($150) and a playful ruffled bottom like the Seyumixi Lace Skirt ($20). To top it off, add a lace underpin like this Reformation Adriano Long Sleeve Top ($118) for a touch of flirty. Who said soccer jerseys are too casual for the office? Update your work uniform with the France National Team 2026 Stadium Home Jersey ($100) and style it with a lightweight midi skirt: Zara's ZW Collection Cape Midi Skirt ($60) is a great option. To top it off, add in your go-to jewelry and favorite structured handbag. All you need for this effortless look is a Brazil shirt — we like the Brazil Heritage Jersey ($85) from FIFA — and a pair of wide legged jeans like the Halara Flex Mid Rise ($60). Head scarves and flags are a huge part of the styling when it comes to soccer jerseys, so don't forget to accessorize your fit with a team scarf in your belt loops or on your head. As for kicks, you can't go wrong with classic white sneakers like the Nike Air Force 1 ($115). If your summer plans include a weekend brunch watch party with the girls, pair your jersey with a tenniscore-inspired pleated skirt. We have been living the the Alo Low-Rise Amp It Up Tennis Skirt ($89) all summer. All that's left? Add an exaggerated chain belt, Calzedonia Short Socks ($11), and Nike Shox Z Sneakers ($40). The capri trend is not going anywhere anytime soon. And for good reason: it's adorable. If you're looking for an option to pair with your favorite team's jersey — whether it's the Spain 2026 Home Yamal Jersey ($130) or another option — the Lululemon Groove Capri ($98) or the Lululemon Align High Rise Crop ($88) are personal favorites. News flash: fashion-forward outfits look even cooler with a jersey on top. To replicate this look, pair a 2026 Argentina Home Jersey ($100) with a statement-making lace midi skirt. This Princess Polly Rennar Maxi Skirt ($69) is similar to the one pictured and adds both lace and polka dots for even more fun. article_title: Welcome to Vanessa Hudgens's "Comfort Era": Inside Her New Campaign
sub_title: Titled "My Comfort Era," the campaign celebrates dressing with intention and authenticity, and embracing the confidence that comes from choosing comfort.
article_content: Fresh off a transformative chapter marked by motherhood, Vanessa Hudgens is approaching getting dressed with a renewed focus on ease, versatility, and authenticity. Hudgens brings her signature blend of ease and modern femininity to the partnership, reflecting a shared belief that the most enduring style is the kind that feels entirely your own. Rooted in the message "Done Proving. Ready for Real Comfort," the campaign speaks to women seeking pieces that feel effortless, considered, and personal. Designed with busy women and new mothers in mind, the collection reflects EKOUAER's commitment to creating clothing that supports every part of modern life. At the center of the collaboration are two standout styles designed to move seamlessly through everyday life. The Bow Tie Front Silk Pajama Set ($14) features playful prints and feminine details, offering a polished take on off-duty dressing. The collection also introduces an effortlessly stylish Wide-Leg Jumpsuit ($33) that delivers the ease of one-piece dressing with versatile styling options for life on the go.

article_title: Keke Palmer Wowed in a Metallic Corset at Essence Festival — Get Her Look Starting at $14
sub_title: See the best celebrity outfits at Essence Festival, from Keke Palmer's metallic corset to Teyana Taylor's floral gown.
article_content: Every year, Essence Festival brings out some of the biggest names in entertainment to the great city of New Orleans for a weekend celebrating Black music, culture, and revelry. Hosted near the July 4 holiday, the landmark event boasts nightly concerts at the Superdome — including Prince in 2014, Janet Jackson in 2022, and Usher in 2024 — as well as a packed schedule of events during the day like the "Black Excellence" brunch and Prime Video "Essence of Leading Ladies" soiree. And celebrities come dressed in their finest summer-ready outfits for the occasion. Keeping the city's scorching temperatures and soaring humidity in mind, stars manage to choose practical looks without sacrificing style. There are plenty of warm-weather-friendly trends on display, from cutouts to micro minis. Embellished one-shoulder dresses, polished skirt suits, and colorful rompers are also in heavy demand at the stylish festival. For concerts, artists think outside the box, choosing bold designs that will make a memorable impact. From a studded bra-and-chaps set to a nude bodysuit covered in glittering gold embellishment, there's no telling what theatrical look you'll witness on the Essence Festival stage. For the 2026 Essence Festival, artists brought their sartorial A-game. Keke Palmer graced the stage to host a live version of her podcast in a gorgeous metallic corset. Brandy looked stunning for her headlining concert at the Superdome wearing a black and white printed Christian Siriano gown. Teyana Taylor wowed at Essence Black Women in Hollywood wearing a printed floral gown that would work perfectly for a summer garden wedding. Shop pieces inspired by Palmer's look below, and keep scrolling for the best celebrity looks from the 2026 Essence Festival (and years prior), from the stage to the red carpet. Keke Palmer took the stage at Essence Festival in a very 2000s-inspired look: a metallic cropped corset paired with scrunched khaki pants. Get Her Look: Edikted Mabel Metallic Faux Leather Corset Top ($61). Oiangi Cargo Capris ($14). House of CB Cadie Satin Corset Top ($149). Wearing Christian Siriano. Keke Palmer shut down the Superdome with her performance of Brandy's "Sitting Up In My Room" during Adam Blackstone's "Waiting to Exhale" tribute. She looked stunning in a gold sequin cutout bra and black capri pants, the latter being a controversial trend that's still dominating our TikTok feed this season. Shop Her Look: Anthropologie The Eve Sequin Bralette ($68). Nookie Tyla Crop Top ($169). Briggs New York Pull on Capris ($20-$21). Skims Smooth Lounge Pajama Capri Pants ($48). Jordan Chiles showed off her chest tattoo in a printed minidress at the "Black Excellence Brunch" presented by L'Oreal Paris on July 6, 2025. Ari Lennox wowed in a pink romper with a halter neckline and ruffled shorts as she performed as part of the VVIP Superlounge Experience at Essence Festival on July 4, 2025. article_title: Shop J Lo's Wedding Guest Look For Taylor and Travis's Wedding — Starting at $70
sub_title: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce tied the knot on Friday, July 3 at Madison Square Garden. Here are the celebrity guests who made our best dressed list.
article_content: Congratulations are in order for Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce after they tied the knot on Friday, July 3 at Madison Square Garden. The wedding weekend has been kept under wraps with only one major confirmation so far: a sign outside MSG reading "JUST&T MARRIED!" that appeared after the ceremony. While we patiently wait for more details to be released, all of our attention has turned to the guest list. The star-studded event included Hollywood stars, NFL players, music legends, and, of course, Swift's inner circle. From her childhood best friend Abigail to icons like Jennifer Lopez, there was no shortage of high-fashion moments. Ahead, we found the best wedding guest looks from Swift and Kelce's big day. For an elegant head-to-toe black outfit, Jennifer Lopez wore a drop-waist Bach Mai gown. While the designer was unaware where she would be wearing the dress when her team requested it, he still thought the choice fit the setting. "I think the silhouette and dramatic volume bring a level of formality befitting for such a momentous occasion," he tells Popsugar. "The high-low hemline and subdued color keep it light and appropriate for a wedding guest." She accessorized the look with a Carolina Herrera Karlita Bow Satin Clutch ($1,490) and Jimmy Choo Max 150 Black Satin Sandals ($1,050). Recreate Lopez's look with these similar dress styles: ASTR the Label Vinya Cotton Dress ($70, originally $158), Almond Muse Francesca Dress ($80, originally $160), Alex & Sophia Juniors' Scoop Neck Shirred Midi Dress ($119), L'Academie Sidney Gown ($288), and Jenny Yoo Shelby Dress ($295). Taylor Swift's life-long best friend Abigail Anderson was in her enchanted era for Friday's nuptials. She wore the Sau Lee Frances Corset Gown ($795) with a floral embroidered corset top and effortlessly draped satin skirt. Camila Cabello opted for a bright color with her wedding guest look via the Zimmermann Luna Lace Billow Gown ($1,980, originally $3,300). Thanks to the sheer lace fabric, the bold hue didn't feel overwhelming but rather romantic given the flowy silhouette. Swift's longtime publicist Tree Paine went for a simple yet structured gown. Her Rachel Gilbert Rowana Gown ($1,650) has strategic ruching that lends itself to an hourglass shape. Pretty in pink, Gigi Hadid showed up with a romantic rose dress from Wiederhoeft's Spring/Summer 2025 collection. Paired with a chunky diamond necklace and soft, dreamy glam, we can't help but imagine Hadid was channeling her inner Barbie. The Wiederhoeft team told Popsugar the dress was requested earlier in spring by Hadid's team, but they weren't sure what event it would be worn for — until now. Selena Gomez's Oscar de la Renta gown captured the perfect level of sparkle. Embellished with thousands of beads and rhinestones, the champagne-gold color felt like the definition of a subtle statement. Some Swifties are also noting that Swift wore a gold dress to Gomez's wedding in September 2025, calling out the connection in shade. In a trendy shade of olive green, Kelsea Ballerini wore a structured Alex Perry gown to celebrate, photographed here by Shervin Lainez before the ceremony. While her exact dress isn't available to shop, it is very similar to the Alex Perry Strapless Longline Corset Twist Drape Column Dress ($2,950). Her pop of red lipstick, which might have been a subtle nod to Swift's favorite lip color . article_title: The Hottest Item in Fashion This Summer? A Soccer Jersey
sub_title: With the World Cup in full swing, soccer jerseys are everywhere. If you want a social cheat code for the summer, we've got you covered on how to style one.
article_content: Not long ago, soccer jerseys were reserved for game days, stadium seats, and devoted fans. Now, they've become one of fashion's most coveted wardrobe staples. The rise of jersey dressing didn't happen overnight though. Fashion has long borrowed from the world of sports, from varsity jackets and tennis skirts to racing-inspired streetwear . Soccer jerseys, in particular, have been steadily gaining momentum over the past few years thanks to influencers and celebrities like Rihanna, Hailey Bieber, and Dua Lipa. Most recently, Sabrina Carpenter wore an England shirt paired over a mini-dress during a performance and Anne Hathaway wore an Arsenal top to the Devil Wears Prada premier in England. For anyone who tracked the tenniscore and blokecore waves, this one won't come as a surprise. In the last three years, high-fashion brands like Balenciaga , Dior , Stella McCartney , and streetwear brands like adidas have partnered with football teams to design special merch. The streetwear retailer teamed up with designer Yohji Yamamoto to create Japan's 2022 jersey and with Wales Bonner to design Jamaica's 2023 jersey. Further, legacy football clubs have even started hiring in-house creative directors to design new team jerseys. This summer, however, the trend is poised to reach a whole new level thanks to the FIFA World Cup — held in the United States , Mexico, and Canada from June 11 to July 19. In fact, soccer jersey sales have grown fivefold in the last 18 months on live shopping app Tilt . With the world's attention turning to international soccer, jerseys are becoming more than just a fashion statement — they're a symbol of excitement, community, and friendly competition. As fans gather in bars, living rooms, parks, and watch parties around the globe, what you wear won't just show off your style, but reveal where your loyalties lie and your dedication to current events. A soccer jersey can instantly kick off a conversation: Are you supporting the defending champions? Pulling for an underdog nation? Watching every match with friends or hosting your own viewing party? Suddenly, your outfit becomes an invitation to connect with fellow fans. It's fashion with built-in small talk. Part of the appeal of the soccer jersey is its versatility. Whether it's the official team jersey, a clever vintage find from the '90s, iconic club colors, or a newly released national team design — soccer jerseys bring lots of personality and can be styled in multiple ways. They're bold without trying too hard, instantly recognizable, and often spark conversations in a way that few fashion pieces can. And unlike many fashion trends , you don't need a designer budget to participate. Once you have the jersey, you can pull from your closet to style the rest — adding wide-leg trousers, straight-leg jeans, puffy skirts, and more. There really is no single way to wear the look. The beauty of the trend lies in making it your own. Now that the games have begun, get inspired to style your jersey for both at-home and buzzy bar watch parties, or, for the lucky ones, in-person stadium matches. Whether you take your cues from the dressed up or down looks below, it's high time you become a well-styled footy fan. Grab your favorite cowboy boots — we like Tecovas Sadie Vintage ($495) — and lean into western wear with this look. For the rest of the fit you'll need a Mexico 2026 Authentic Home Jersey ($150) and a playful ruffled bottom like the Seyumixi Lace Skirt ($20). To top it off, add a lace underpin like this Reformation Adriano Long Sleeve Top ($118) for a touch of flirty. Who said soccer jerseys are too casual for the office? Update your work uniform with the France National Team 2026 Stadium Home Jersey ($100) and style it with a lightweight midi skirt: Zara's ZW Collection Cape Midi Skirt ($60) is a great option. To top it off, add in your go-to jewelry and favorite structured handbag. All you need for this effortless look is a Brazil shirt — we like the Brazil Heritage Jersey ($85) from FIFA — and a pair of wide legged jeans like the Halara Flex Mid Rise ($60). Head scarves and flags are a huge part of the styling when it comes to soccer jerseys, so don't forget to accessorize your fit with a team scarf in your belt loops or on your head. As for kicks, you can't go wrong with classic white sneakers like the Nike Air Force 1 ($115). If your summer plans include a weekend brunch watch party with the girls, pair your jersey with a tenniscore-inspired pleated skirt. We have been living the the Alo Low-Rise Amp It Up Tennis Skirt ($89) all summer. All that's left? Add an exaggerated chain belt, Calzedonia Short Socks ($11), and Nike Shox Z Sneakers ($40). The capri trend is not going anywhere anytime soon. And for good reason: it's adorable. If you're looking for an option to pair with your favorite team's jersey — whether it's the Spain 2026 Home Yamal Jersey ($130) or another option — the Lululemon Groove Capri ($98) or the Lululemon Align High Rise Crop ($88) are personal favorites. News flash: fashion-forward outfits look even cooler with a jersey on top. To replicate this look, pair a 2026 Argentina Home Jersey ($100) with a statement-making lace midi skirt. This Princess Polly Rennar Maxi Skirt ($69) is similar to the one pictured and adds both lace and polka dots for even more fun. article_content: Fresh off a transformative chapter marked by motherhood, Vanessa Hudgens is approaching getting dressed with a renewed focus on ease, versatility, and authenticity. Titled "My Comfort Era," the campaign celebrates dressing with intention and authenticity, and embracing the confidence that comes from choosing comfort without compromise. Hudgens brings her signature blend of ease and modern femininity to the partnership, reflecting a shared belief that the most enduring style is the kind that feels entirely your own. Rooted in the message "Done Proving. Ready for Real Comfort," the campaign speaks to women seeking pieces that feel effortless, considered, and personal. Designed with busy women and new mothers in mind, the collection reflects EKOUAER's commitment to creating clothing that supports every part of modern life. At the center of the collaboration are two standout styles designed to move seamlessly through everyday life. The Bow Tie Front Silk Pajama Set ($14) features playful prints and feminine details, offering a polished take on off-duty dressing. The collection also introduces an effortlessly stylish Wide-Leg Jumpsuit ($33) that delivers the ease of one-piece dressing with versatile styling options for life on the go.

article_title: 10 Father’s Day Gifts at Tecovas, From Bestselling Boots to Elevated Basics
sub_title: We found the best Father's Day gifts at Tecovas, from luxury cowboy boots to everyday work shirts.
article_content: When searching for the perfect gift, it's easy to overthink — especially for Father's Day . The best advice is to keep your criteria simple. Look for something high quality that will hold up for years to come — bonus points if it's something that they might not necessarily think to buy for themselves. article_title: Timothée and Kylie Are the Best Dressed Courtside Couple — Shop Their Looks From $20
sub_title: Celebrity courtside fashion is iconic for a reason. Here are the top 10 celebrity courtside looks to inspire your next sporty NBA look.
article_content: The one unifier of NBA games? The celebrity courtside fashion. Whether you are there to watch your favorite team play or are just cosplaying a sports fan for the day, spotting the range of sporty style is half the fun. The front row of seats that line the basketball court is affectionately named "celebrity row," as it is regularly reserved for A-list celebrities and is always captured by the cameras. You can spot the same die-hard fans (yes, that's you, Timothée Chalamet) or an occasional surprise guest, wearing their finest fan fashion. From vintage Knicks starter jackets to lucky purses, there is no telling what you will spot as a spectator. Ahead, we found the best celebrity courtside fashion moments to help inspire your next NBA fan outfit. Whether you believe in superstitions or not, ask any Knicks fan and they will tell you the power of Jordyn Wood's lucky purse. Part of her own accessories brand, she carries this leather orange clutch to cheer on her fiancé, Karl-Anthony Towns. Pre-order her exact bag: Woods By Jordan Tux Clutch Mini 'Summer Citrus' in Orange Ostrich ($125). Arguably the most iconic courtside couple, you will always spot Chalamet and Jenner repping classic blue-and-orange Knicks colors. Here, Jenner showed off a vintage Knicks windbreaker paired with a classic dark blue jean, while Chalamet sported a sleek suede set. Shop: Zennioptical Blue with Blue Mirror Wraparound Sunglasses ($20). Pacsun Tan Faux Leather Billie Gas Jacket ($45, originally $100). Open Edit Mid Rise Wide Leg Jean ($45, originally $90). NBA Store New York Knicks G-III 4Her Lightweight Oversized Full-Zip Jacket ($120). Not all courtside appearances require team spirit. Instead of repping flashy colors, Swift opted for a black tank with a chain-embellished trim via the latest Stella McCartney x H&M collab. While her exact top is sold out, we found similar styles to recreate the look. Shop: All Saints Lucy Tank Top ($129). Generation Love Mabel Chain Trim Top ($148). Forever 21 Plus Size Seamless Chain-Trim Tank ($11, originally $20). These two music legends are proof that high fashion mixed with high energy is the secret to creating memorable courtside moments. We especially love Cardi's cropped leather jacket, which feels effortless yet sophisticated. The Jenner sisters cosign the easiest spectator fashion formula — a classic white or black tank top paired with leather pants. They customized the look with different accessories to make the standard outfit feel a bit more personal. To cheer on her now-fiancé, Kyle Kuzma, Harlow embraced winter whites from head to toe. From the fuzzy bucket hat to the chunky Moon Boots, the neutral color palette stood out against the sporty crowd. Taylor found the perfect balance of style and comfort with this courtside look. Sticking to the basics, she paired a white cropped T-shirt with baggy cargo pants. To make the ensemble feel cohesive, she even matched her maroon frames to her Nike sneakers. When in doubt, take a page out of Goulding's fashion book and opt for a classic all-black outfit. The combination of black denim, a leather jacket, and mesh flats feels elevated while still being subtle. Adele's courtside moments often end up as memes, but her sense of style is nothing to joke about. Here, the singer paired baggy black trousers with a bright white power pump. Leave it to Megan Thee Stallion to be anything but subtle when attending a sports game. From the fur jacket and fuzzy YSL bag to the chunky Timberland boots, she wanted to make a statement. article_title: Ariana Madix's Skin-Baring "Love Island" Dress Requires Lots of Fashion Tape
sub_title: Ariana Madix is a style star on "Love Island USA" with the standout outfits to match. Shop our favorites here.
article_content: Ariana Madix's sartorial sense first captured our hearts during her time on Bravo's "Vanderpump Rules." From the revenge dress shared all over social media to her go-to designer handbag , we knew she was a style star since her debut back in season two. Since then, she's become a bona fide fashion darling as the impeccably-dressed host of "Love Island USA." The actress and restaurateur, who was recently a guest on Popsugar Re:Play , says her TV hosting outfits are like her "children" — and, given the effort that goes into choosing each one, the analogy fits. This season, Madix's looks are already the talk of the "Love Island USA" universe, from a Tom Ford backless gown to Jean Paul Gaultier's dot-print set. And there are plenty of outfits and glam moments to come from her time in Fiji. Working closely with stylist Emily Men , with assistance from Emily Abbey , Madix chooses summer-ready outfits that exude main-character energy, perfect to recreate if you're hosting a birthday dinner or even attending a fancy party. Whether she's strutting in a gown covered in colorful paillettes or posing in a glittering metallic low-rise skirt, she ensures all eyes are on her with every outfit change. Ahead, check out Ariana Madix's best "Love Island USA" looks from season eight and beyond — and shop available and inspired pieces in time for your next event. Jean Paul Gaultier High-Neck Dots Print Top ($311, originally $450) and Jean Paul Gaultier Re-Edition Flared Printed Trousers ($504, originally $630) The reality star reminded us that "Love Island" isn't just about dresses. She showed off her curves with a Jean Paul Gaultier turtleneck and flared pant set in the brand's famous illusion dot print. Tom Ford Asymmetric Backless Evening Dress ($6,890) One thing about Madix? She knows how to make an entrance. Kicking off episode 1, Madix stunned in a backless Tom Ford gown with an abstract halter top. We found similar options here: Superdown Emilijiah Maxi Dress ($76), Lovers and Friends Athenna Gown ($282, originally $299), and Solace London Krista Maxi Dress ($401, originally $520). Hello Molly Soft Island Dreams Long Sleeve Top Pink ($80) and Hello Molly Soft Island Dreams Maxi Skirt Pink ($60) The perfect mix of tropical and flirty, Madix kicked off season 8 with a hot pink skirt and ruffled top set. Ariana Madix did a superb job hosting the "Love Island" season 7 reunion wearing a cutout sequin gown from Jean Pierre Khoury. Ariana Madix closed the seventh season in one of her best looks yet: a Defaïence white top and a Shani Shemer Swimwear skirt that felt like she was channeling a mermaid. For episode 30, the host nailed the fruit trend in a black sequin minidress with watermelon, lemon, and cherry embellishment by Leslie Amon. The reality star stunned in a hooded dress that felt like an optical illusion, appearing like two separate pieces though it's connected at the waist. She finished the look with sold out Akira embellished gladiator sandals. Madix embraced the cutout trend in a silver sequin dress with chest, ab, and hip cutouts by Mother of All. Madix posed in a shimmering Hana Official custom dress for Episode 27. For Episode 23, the Florida native embraced color in a gradiant striped strapless dress. The host slipped in an Urban Palais Couture gown for Episode 22 that featured 20+ cutouts on each side. The one-of-a-kind gown is custom-made by the Mexican brand. For Episode 19, Madix went the shimmery route in a halter maxi dress covered in netting and sequin pailettes by Chaku Chaku Handcrafts . Madix wore the perfect summer-ready frock on Episode 17, posing in a Ramy Brook minidress with a plunging neckline and allover floral print. The former "Dancing With the Stars" contestant stunned in a LaQuan Smith sleeveless gown with an ab cutout that went viral on TikTok. A noted fan of LaQuan Smith, it's no surprise Madix chose a look from the designer's Fall 2024 collection for Episode 12. The crop top and hip-cutout skirt is sold out, but you can find similar styles to recreate the look on your own. The "Something About Her" restaurateur appeared on "Aftersun" in a Michael Costello x Revolve Blair cumin brown gathered skirt with a thigh-high slit and a matching crop top, which is currently sold out. All eyes were on Madix when she surprised viewers with a totally new hair color on Episode 9, styled with a red cutout minidress and a dramatic floor-length jacket. Fans from the "Vanderpump Rules" era will note the similarities (in color and cutouts) to the revenge dress she wore for the series's penultimate reunion show. Madix dazzled in a metallic cowl neck gown from Lapointe, which she wore off the shoulder. She completed the look with layered gold chokers, cuff bracelets, and a long braid. Ariana gave us all vacation inspo with her breezy PatBo crochet dress and a head of beachy waves to match. When Madix stepped out in a glittering gown at the beginning season 7, we knew it had to be a special piece. As we later discovered, the cutout gown is indeed custom designed by Taylor Cox and it features over 3,000 beads and crystals . The little black dress is a staple in Madix's closet, and for Episode 1, she pulled out an embellished ruched number from Area. Nothing says Fiji vacation quite like a yellow crochet set. The former "Vanderpump Rules" star glowed in a marigold netted skirt and matching top from Australian brand Eliya The Label. — Additional reporting by Adelaide Giesey Jessica C. article_title: A Shopping Editor's Festival Season Essentials, From Face Gems to Cowboy Boots
sub_title: Shop the most popular music festival fashion and beauty trends and lifestyle essentials, including face gems, cowboy boots, portable fans, and more.
article_content: Festival season is officially here. It's time to update your wardrobe, switch up your makeup routine, try a new hairstyle, and prepare your bag of lifestyle must haves for the occasion. What does that look like for spring and summer 2026? For fashion, we're seeing lots of '90s and 2000s-era staples: oversize jeans, naked dresses, sequin embellishment, and — of course — corsets. While Western and boho will claim their usual top spot in festival street style, this year, you can also expect crochet and lots of sparkle, bringing a tropical and nightlife vibe to festival outfits. In the beauty realm, think a mix of '90s face gems, glass skin, beach waves, and tousled bobs. And you'll want to pack the usual lifestyle essentials: the best sneakers for getting around , face SPF , electrolyte hydration like Electrolit, Listerine on-the-go packets, hands-free bags , water bottles (if allowed), handheld fans, and the list goes on. Whether you're headed to Governor's Ball or Lollapalooza, check out some of our go-to products for festival season ahead, many of which have been recently reviewed by our editors. Listerine Total Care Mouthwash in Extra Mild ($9) Festival season means long days of hopping from stage to stage to after party, and if you're like me, you want your breath fresh throughout. I swear by Listerine Total Care mouthwash in the morning, which now boasts different intensities (Extra Mild, Mild, and Classic Intense) as well as alcohol-free options — my go-to is Extra Mild. I also pack Listerine Travel Essentials Cool Mint PocketPaks Breath Strips ($6, originally $7) in my handbag to freshen my breath after meals on the festival grounds. Electrolit Electrolytes Powder Packets 8-Pack ($12) When you're walking around and partying all day at a music festival, staying hydrated is critical. I love electrolytes to hydrate and rehydrate while dancing all day in the heat, and for recovering after long days out and about. This Electrolit brand comes highly-recommended from athletes, and my favorite flavor is fruit punch (but the grape, strawberry kiwi, and lemon lime flavors are also great). Electrolit is the official electrolyte hydration sponsor for Governor's Ball, so if you're attending, be sure to stop by their hydration station for samples, fun activations, and more. iWalk Portable Charger 4800mAh Power Bank ($23) As someone who once lost power after getting separated from the group at Coachella and had to hop a fence, walk 3 miles, and wait 2 hours for an Uber back to the rental, I can assure you: a portable charger goes a long way. This option stands out from the rest with its conveniently tiny size, fast-charging power bank, and cordless design. Our editor raved about the tech find in her iWalk portable charger review . Editor Quote: : "This isn't your typical clunky, tricky-to-use iPhone charger that takes forever to charge or, even worse, takes up a ton of space in your bag. Within the span of only an hour, the portable battery can be fully charged and ready to use as needed. With this tool, I can forgo a charging cord altogether as the product can be inserted straight into my iPhone's lightning port, which is fantastic because it's one less thing for me to have to worry about carrying around or transporting when I'm on the go." — Kyley Warren, former assistant shopping editor Owala 32-Ounce FreeSip Stainless-Steel Water Bottle ($35) It's safe to say these Owala FreeShip water bottles everywhere. During festival season, they're perfect for stowing away in your waist bag or tote until you get a chance for a refill. The leakproof valve means you won't dampen the rest of the belongings in your bag. Plus, you can shop from plenty of different colorways to match your outfit. Our editor wrote an Owala Water Bottle review and gave it 5 stars. Editor Quote: "Beyond its aesthetics, I fell in love with the dual-function straw. What makes it so great is that you can either sip through the built-in straw (ideal for avoiding spills when it's full) or swig from the spout opening when you need a lot more water at once (perfect for those intense Sculpt classes). [...] It's been my go-to emotional support water bottle for the past six months. Trust me, you won't regret buying it." — Marisa Petrarca, former PS contributor Jisulife Handheld Fan Pro Series ($60, originally $70) This pocket fan will come in handy when you're out all day in the sweltering heat. It provides an impressive 9m/s wind speed, it's rechargeable with an accompanying power bank, and can go up to 15 hours of cooling time when fully charged. "Summer House"'s Ciara Miller swears by it, telling Popsugar : "It's functional, affordable, and you can find them everywhere — I got mine on Amazon." Teenitor Self Adhesive Face Gems and Pearls For Makeup ($5, originally $7) This pack of face jewels comes with two sheets of rhinestone stickers, one sheet of hair pearls, and one sheet of multicolor gemstones. Once your skin is prepped with makeup, you can add these to your look to achieve a beauty moment that's even more done up. These face gems are made from high quality ABS material without odor, and they don't irritate your skin. Lilly Lashes Multicolored Individual Faux Mink Lash Flares ($14) Get creative with your beauty look this festival season and decorate your eyes with accent lashes, blending them with your shadow for a prismatic effect. While you might not expect it, these are reusable up to three times with proper care, but they come with a whopping total of 32 clusters, so they should keep you occupied for all of the concerts you've got on the agenda. Billie AHA pH Adjusting Deodorant Gel ($14) This roll-on AHA deodorant is getting plenty of hype for its promising formula that works to exfoliate the skin, unclog pores, block odor-causing bacteria, and even out the skin's texture and tone. Available in three different scents, it's perfect for those with sensitive skin on the go. Our editor gave it four stars in her Billie AHA Deodorant review . Editor Quote: "From workouts to stuffy subways, or anything that typically makes me break a sweat, I still can't smell any trace of my body odor. Plus, the formula goes on clear and dries quickly, so you don't need to worry about staining clothes or getting the gel everywhere." — Anvita Reddy, former assistant shopping editor Evian Facial Spray ($15) There's a reason Evian facial spray is a bestseller: it conveniently offers micro-droplet mist to hydrate and nourish your skin at the exact time you need it. It will definitely come in handy for long days in the sun or desert heat, and is available in travel size as well: Evian Facial Spray Travel Size Pack of 3 ($25). One/Size Powder Melt Glass Setting Spray ($34) Between the heat, sweat, and possible rain, we don't blame you for being worried about your makeup staying in place at music festivals. But we do have a solution: One/Size's melt glass setting spray. The matte version is perpetually-viral but our editors love this option for its glowy, radiant finish. One editor used it while partying for 11 hours on Juneteenth and another for a weeklong vacation in Barcelona; in both cases, their makeup stayed put. It's so good it won a Popsugar 2026 Beauty Award . Read our editor's One/Size Powder Melt Glass Setting Spray review for more details. Editor Quote: "No matter how much powder I apply to my face, I can spritz this on and look like I just got the best facial of my life. In fact, the first time I wore it out, my ex-boyfriend actually told me that my face looked 'really glowy.' A man noticing that my face is glowing? I'll take 10 more setting sprays, please. Plus, this product works hard to keep my makeup in place. I wore it during a sweaty week in Barcelona traipsing around the city and at a music festival, and my look stayed locked. Honestly, it's my core belief this product was sent straight from heaven." — Renee Rodriguez, senior beauty staff writer and social producer Kosas DreamBeam Silicone-Free Mineral Sunscreen SPF 40 ($40) This mineral formula face sunscreen with non-nano zinc oxide provides SPF 40 protection and features ceramides, hyaluronic acid, and peptides to moisturize and soothe the skin. It blends easily with makeup, if you're going that route for your music festival, but the Sunlit shade also provides a natural bronze if you choose to wear it alone. Get more details in our editor's Kosas DreamBeam SPF 40 review . Editor Quote: "I've tried countless face sunscreen formulas over the years, but the ones that make it into my skin-care routine long-term have to feel good on my skin (not greasy or heavy) and layer well under makeup." — Jessica Harrington, beauty lead Cotton Paisley Pattern Bandanas, Pack of 3 ($7) Whether you tie yours into a top, wear it in your hair, or wrap it around your arm, a bandana is a go-to festival add-on. And it certainly comes in handy when trying to protect yourself from illness from inhaling too much dust otherwise known as Coachella cough . Consider this affordable option from Amazon, which comes in three neutral colorways to complement any outfit you pack. Packism Clear Fanny Pack ($10, originally $17) Going hands-free at a festival is a reasonable preference, but while '80s-inspired waist bags were popular in previous years, a slightly more functional crossbody that's a little larger will likely feel more secure while you're walking around. This one is also a top pick on Amazon, and it's clear, which is helpful for stages that require see-through bags. Free People Essential Beach Hat ($28) A casual throw-on-and-go look, this bucket hat is ideal for keeping cool and protecting your skin from the sun's harmful ways all while adding a Bohemian flair to your look. When styling this hat, don't overthink it: add it to everything from a crochet dress to denim. Added bonus? You can pull it out for mornings spent at the pool, too. Merch Traffic Aaliyah Off the Shoulder Graphic T-Shirt ($29) Vintage-inspired graphic tees are selling at an all-time high this festival season, but we especially love styles with prints that speak to our favorite artists like Aaliyah. After all, that just makes your look so much more special — especially when the shirt can be considered a collectible. Uratot Cotton Sports Shorts ($37) Jump on the hot pants trend with this perfect pack of seven mixed-color shorts, each pair replete with white piping for a sporty vibe. The material is breathable and sweat-absorbent, ideal for when you're in the summer heat at a music festival. Victoria's Secret Dream Angels Wicked Unlined Lace Balconette Bra ($50) A pretty, comfortable bralette is a lingerie staple for any festival outfit, whether you're wearing it under a sheer dress or as a top by itself. Go for a retro-inspired polka dot print or solid color — this style is available in over 50 different colorways. Quay Call the Shots Sunglasses ($53, originally $75) A pair of sunglasses makes for the perfect accessory, especially in a bold, solid black shade. These also come with a soft pouch, which is perfect for stowing away in a smaller bag while you're at the festival. Plus, the cat-eye style is still trending and super flattering no matter your face shape. Our editor raved about these sunglasses in our Quay sunglasses review . Editor Quote: "There's nothing I love more than a pair of black cat-eye sunglasses — and this is my favorite style yet. article_content: Festival season is officially here. In the beauty realm, think a mix of '90s face gems, glass skin, beach waves, and tousled bobs. Whether you're headed to Governor's Ball or Lollapalooza, check out some of our go-to products for festival season ahead, many of which have been recently reviewed by our editors. I swear by Listerine Total Care mouthwash in the morning, which now boasts different intensities (Extra Mild, Mild, and Classic Intense) as well as alcohol-free options — my go-to is Extra Mild. article_title: Shop J Lo's Wedding Guest Look For Taylor and Travis's Wedding — Starting at $70
sub_title: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce tied the knot on Friday, July 3 at Madison Square Garden. Here are the celebrity guests who made our best dressed list.
article_content: Congratulations are in order for Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce after they tied the knot on Friday, July 3 at Madison Square Garden. The wedding weekend has been kept under wraps with only one major confirmation so far: a sign outside MSG reading "JUST&T MARRIED!" that appeared after the ceremony. While we patiently wait for more details to be released, all of our attention has turned to the guest list. The star-studded event included Hollywood stars, NFL players, music legends, and, of course, Swift's inner circle. From her childhood best friend Abigail to icons like Jennifer Lopez, there was no shortage of high-fashion moments. Ahead, we found the best wedding guest looks from Swift and Kelce's big day. For an elegant head-to-toe black outfit, Jennifer Lopez wore a drop-waist Bach Mai gown. While the designer was unaware where she would be wearing the dress when her team requested it, he still thought the choice fit the setting. "I think the silhouette and dramatic volume bring a level of formality befitting for such a momentous occasion," he tells Popsugar. "The high-low hemline and subdued color keep it light and appropriate for a wedding guest." She accessorized the look with a Carolina Herrera Karlita Bow Satin Clutch ($1,490) and Jimmy Choo Max 150 Black Satin Sandals ($1,050). Recreate Lopez's look with these similar dress styles: ASTR the Label Vinya Cotton Dress ($70, originally $158), Almond Muse Francesca Dress ($80, originally $160), Alex & Sophia Juniors' Scoop Neck Shirred Midi Dress ($119), L'Academie Sidney Gown ($288), and Jenny Yoo Shelby Dress ($295). Taylor Swift's life-long best friend Abigail Anderson was in her enchanted era for Friday's nuptials. She wore the Sau Lee Frances Corset Gown ($795) with a floral embroidered corset top and effortlessly draped satin skirt. Camila Cabello opted for a bright color with her wedding guest look via the Zimmermann Luna Lace Billow Gown ($1,980, originally $3,300). Thanks to the sheer lace fabric, the bold hue didn't feel overwhelming but rather romantic given the flowy silhouette. Swift's longtime publicist Tree Paine went for a simple yet structured gown. Her Rachel Gilbert Rowana Gown ($1,650) has strategic ruching that lends itself to an hourglass shape. Pretty in pink, Gigi Hadid showed up with a romantic rose dress from Wiederhoeft's Spring/Summer 2025 collection. Paired with a chunky diamond necklace and soft, dreamy glam, we can't help but imagine Hadid was channeling her inner Barbie. The Wiederhoeft team told Popsugar the dress was requested earlier in spring by Hadid's team, but they weren't sure what event it would be worn for — until now. Selena Gomez's Oscar de la Renta gown captured the perfect level of sparkle. Embellished with thousands of beads and rhinestones, the champagne-gold color felt like the definition of a subtle statement. Some Swifties are also noting that Swift wore a gold dress to Gomez's wedding in September 2025, calling out the connection in shade. In a trendy shade of olive green, Kelsea Ballerini wore a structured Alex Perry gown to celebrate, photographed here by Shervin Lainez before the ceremony. While her exact dress isn't available to shop, it is very similar to the Alex Perry Strapless Longline Corset Twist Drape Column Dress ($2,950). For a slightly different take on a gold wedding guest look, Karlie Kloss looked stunning in her strapless satin Tove gown from the fall 2026 collection. Our favorite accessory? Her pop of red lipstick, which might have been a subtle nod to Swift's favorite lip color . Proving that sometimes a spectacular fabric can be the only statement you need, Tate McRae stunned in a metallic vintage Valentino gown sourced from Raffe Vintage. The light bounced off the V-cut top and tiered skirt. To match the unofficially confirmed garden theme, actress Joey King chose a black halter Leo Lin gown with blue and green floral embroidery. We love how the whimsical details add a bit of playfulness to the moment. To celebrate her fellow country star, Miranda Lambert stepped out in a black halter dress. We especially love the lace detailing, which played up the otherwise traditional design for the special occasion. Adelaide Giesey (she/her) is a shopping writer at Popsugar. article_title: The Hottest Item in Fashion This Summer? A Soccer Jersey
sub_title: With the World Cup in full swing, soccer jerseys are everywhere. If you want a social cheat code for the summer, we've got you covered on how to style one.
article_content: Not long ago, soccer jerseys were reserved for game days, stadium seats, and devoted fans. Now, they've become one of fashion's most coveted wardrobe staples. The rise of jersey dressing didn't happen overnight though. Fashion has long borrowed from the world of sports, from varsity jackets and tennis skirts to racing-inspired streetwear . Soccer jerseys, in particular, have been steadily gaining momentum over the past few years thanks to influencers and celebrities like Rihanna, Hailey Bieber, and Dua Lipa. Most recently, Sabrina Carpenter wore an England shirt paired over a mini-dress during a performance and Anne Hathaway wore an Arsenal top to the Devil Wears Prada premier in England. For anyone who tracked the tenniscore and blokecore waves, this one won't come as a surprise. In the last three years, high-fashion brands like Balenciaga , Dior , Stella McCartney , and streetwear brands like adidas have partnered with football teams to design special merch. The streetwear retailer teamed up with designer Yohji Yamamoto to create Japan's 2022 jersey and with Wales Bonner to design Jamaica's 2023 jersey. Further, legacy football clubs have even started hiring in-house creative directors to design new team jerseys. This summer, however, the trend is poised to reach a whole new level thanks to the FIFA World Cup — held in the United States , Mexico, and Canada from June 11 to July 19. In fact, soccer jersey sales have grown fivefold in the last 18 months on live shopping app Tilt . With the world's attention turning to international soccer, jerseys are becoming more than just a fashion statement — they're a symbol of excitement, community, and friendly competition. As fans gather in bars, living rooms, parks, and watch parties around the globe, what you wear won't just show off your style, but reveal where your loyalties lie and your dedication to current events. A soccer jersey can instantly kick off a conversation: Are you supporting the defending champions? Pulling for an underdog nation? Watching every match with friends or hosting your own viewing party? article_title: Ciara Miller and the Art of Dressing for Revenge
sub_title: See all the celebrities who have worn a revenge dress through the years, from Princess Diana to Ciara Miller on "Summer House."
article_content: Princess Diana in an off-shoulder minidress when Prince Charles went public with his affair. Mariah Carey in a hip-high slit after leaving a tumultuous marriage. Ariana Madix in a fiery-red cutout set in the wake of Scandoval , when she caught her longterm boyfriend Tom Sandoval cheating with her friend Raquel Leviss. And most recently, Ciara Miller in a revenge bra and maxi skirt look to film the "Summer House" ten reunion after Scamanda , when Miller's best friend Amanda Batula secretly started dating her on-again, off-again ex-boyfriend West Wilson. The revenge look isn't a new phenomenon, but it remains at the forefront of everyone's minds. Inspired by the black mini worn by the Princess of Wales in the 1990s, the modern revenge look is fashion at its most communicative. It's bold, fitted in silhouette, and red or black or cream in color. It boasts plunging necklines and conspicuous cutouts, high splits and open backs. It's a comeback story, rendered sartorially. Despite the revenge look's enduring legacy, I always felt uneasy about it. How vengeful is a sultry outfit anyway? A better act of revenge would be, well, cheating back, as Chloe Bailey sings . What's more, the concept of "revenge dressing" frames a woman's wardrobe and appearance as her primary weapons of power. What about revenge accomplishments? Revenge art? Revenge careers? Why is it that — after a woman's been wronged — the statement that really makes an impact revolves around how she looks? I'm also not sold on the idea of dressing with the offending party in mind. Fashion is such a personal, intimate act for me; I get dressed based on my mood, my desires, my social calendar for the week. I don't want that process to be hijacked by someone else, let alone someone who caused me harm. [T]here's something empowering about the revenge dress. It speaks to the confidence of a woman who knows that her value goes far beyond how she was treated. But I learned — through experience — that there's something empowering about the revenge dress. It speaks to the confidence of a woman who knows that her value goes far beyond how she was treated. My revenge dress story is pretty typical. Several years ago, pre-pandemic, I found myself on the verge of a break up. We had been so in sync; we had amazing chemistry; we saw a future together with kids, pets, and even a few business ventures. But when I signed into his Netflix account, of all things, I saw a newly-created profile bearing another woman's name — someone he'd visited once to help her fix a broken water pipe, allegedly. I inquired about it, and our relationship quickly unraveled from there. He was belligerent and I was crushed. And the New Year's Eve party invite I had accepted a few days prior hung in the balance. I was not in the mood to dress up and be around people. But then I reconsidered; I usually enjoy a night of revelry and I refused to let him take that away from me. I landed on a dress that encapsulated that mood perfectly. A sequin micro mini with exaggerated sleeves and a plunging neckline. It was just the boost I needed to feel like myself again. It's the same energy Tina Turner emanated when she stepped out in 1986 after leaving her abusive marriage. She donned a skin-tight leather Azzedine Alaïa gown with four cutouts down the side, her hair in a blonde spiky mullet. Megan Thee Stallion had a similar air of confidence as she posed in a red Outcast cutout dress at her Hot Girl Summer Swimwear fashion show — fresh off a breakup with NBA player Klay Thompson. Dressing for revenge is less about retaliation, and more a bold declaration of self-love. It's putting on a brave face and a cutout dress or a bra and maxi skirt — and letting the world know that what happened to you didn't break you and will not define you. Keep scrolling to glean your own confidence from the best celebrity revenge moments of all time, from Princess Diana to Ciara Miller. Princess Diana wore the original revenge dress to a Vanity Fair party at the Serpentine Gallery, at the same time her then-husband Prince Charles publicly admitted to cheating on her with Queen Consort Camilla Parker-Bowles. After divorcing her abusive husband Ike Turner, the late Tina Turner embraced a new era of revenge dressing, choosing bold and daring dresses like this leather cutout style from Azzedine Alaïa (pictured). Mariah Carey celebrated her emancipation from a toxic relationship with music executive Tommy Mottola with a whole new look. Free from her controlling ex-husband, she hit the red carpet circa 1998 in a hip-high-slit skirt and bra top. Shakira appeared to pay homage to the original revenge dress in her look at the 2022 Cannes Film Festival. Following news that her long-term boyfriend, Gerard Pique, was having an affair, the "TQG" singer posed in a gown with the same plunging neckline and black color as Princess Diana's look. For a modern twist, Shakira added sheer gloves, strappy sandals, and a high leg slit. While her fiancé, soccer player Sebastian Lletget, was posting a cheating admission on Instagram, Becky G was living her best life at the iHeartRadio Music Awards. She twirled in a sheer lace gown with a plunging neckline and open shoulders. The Bravo universe was shaken to its core when news dropped that "Vanderpump Rules" star Tom Sandoval cheated on fan-favorite Ariana Madix with her friend and castmate Raquel Welch. In the mid-season trailer, Madix famously told Sandoval, "[I want] for you to die," and she came to the reunion dressed to kill . The "Something About Her" co-owner wore a red-hot top and skirt from Mônot, with chest, ab, and waist cutouts on full display. Outcast Celine Mini Dress ($75) Megan Thee Stallion had a head-turning fashion moment at Miami Swim Week, backstage at her own Hot Girl Summer swimwear show. Fresh from a breakup where she revealed she'd been cheated on by NBA player Klay Thompson, she wowed in a red cutout mini that's still available to shop. Hot girl summer, indeed. Ciara Miller continues to handle the fallout from #Scamanda with elegance and grace, and her revenge look for the "Summer House" season 10 reunion is just the latest example. Wearing a bra top and low-rise maxi skirt with draping throughout, Miller's outfit made it clear that she's a force to be reckoned with and no one — least of all, a friend and ex who'd betray her for a casual hookup — will slow her down. — Additional reporting by Naomi Parris Jessica C. article_title: Welcome to Vanessa Hudgens's "Comfort Era": Inside Her New Campaign
sub_title: Titled "My Comfort Era," the campaign celebrates dressing with intention and authenticity, and embracing the confidence that comes from choosing comfort.
article_content: Fresh off a transformative chapter marked by motherhood, Vanessa Hudgens is approaching getting dressed with a renewed focus on ease, versatility, and authenticity. This outlook is at the center of her campaign with sleepwear brand EKOUAER . Titled "My Comfort Era," the campaign celebrates dressing with intention and authenticity, and embracing the confidence that comes from choosing comfort without compromise. Hudgens brings her signature blend of ease and modern femininity to the partnership, reflecting a shared belief that the most enduring style is the kind that feels entirely your own. Rooted in the message "Done Proving. Ready for Real Comfort," the campaign speaks to women seeking pieces that feel effortless, considered, and personal. Designed with busy women and new mothers in mind, the collection reflects EKOUAER's commitment to creating clothing that supports every part of modern life. At the center of the collaboration are two standout styles designed to move seamlessly through everyday life. The Bow Tie Front Silk Pajama Set ($14) features playful prints and feminine details, offering a polished take on off-duty dressing. The collection also introduces an effortlessly stylish Wide-Leg Jumpsuit ($33) that delivers the ease of one-piece dressing with versatile styling options for life on the go.

article_title: Ciara Miller and the Art of Dressing for Revenge
sub_title: See all the celebrities who have worn a revenge dress through the years, from Princess Diana to Ciara Miller on "Summer House."
article_content: Princess Diana in an off-shoulder minidress when Prince Charles went public with his affair. Mariah Carey in a hip-high slit after leaving a tumultuous marriage. Ariana Madix in a fiery-red cutout set in the wake of Scandoval , when she caught her longterm boyfriend Tom Sandoval cheating with her friend Raquel Leviss. And most recently, Ciara Miller in a revenge bra and maxi skirt look to film the "Summer House" ten reunion after Scamanda , when Miller's best friend Amanda Batula secretly started dating her on-again, off-again ex-boyfriend West Wilson. The revenge look isn't a new phenomenon, but it remains at the forefront of everyone's minds. Inspired by the black mini worn by the Princess of Wales in the 1990s, the modern revenge look is fashion at its most communicative. It's bold, fitted in silhouette, and red or black or cream in color. It boasts plunging necklines and conspicuous cutouts, high splits and open backs. It's a comeback story, rendered sartorially. Despite the revenge look's enduring legacy, I always felt uneasy about it. How vengeful is a sultry outfit anyway? A better act of revenge would be, well, cheating back, as Chloe Bailey sings . What's more, the concept of "revenge dressing" frames a woman's wardrobe and appearance as her primary weapons of power. What about revenge accomplishments? Revenge art? Revenge careers? Why is it that — after a woman's been wronged — the statement that really makes an impact revolves around how she looks? I'm also not sold on the idea of dressing with the offending party in mind. Fashion is such a personal, intimate act for me; I get dressed based on my mood, my desires, my social calendar for the week. I don't want that process to be hijacked by someone else, let alone someone who caused me harm. [T]here's something empowering about the revenge dress. It speaks to the confidence of a woman who knows that her value goes far beyond how she was treated. But I learned — through experience — that there's something empowering about the revenge dress. It speaks to the confidence of a woman who knows that her value goes far beyond how she was treated. My revenge dress story is pretty typical. Several years ago, pre-pandemic, I found myself on the verge of a break up. We had been so in sync; we had amazing chemistry; we saw a future together with kids, pets, and even a few business ventures. But when I signed into his Netflix account, of all things, I saw a newly-created profile bearing another woman's name — someone he'd visited once to help her fix a broken water pipe, allegedly. I inquired about it, and our relationship quickly unraveled from there. He was belligerent and I was crushed. And the New Year's Eve party invite I had accepted a few days prior hung in the balance. I was not in the mood to dress up and be around people. But then I reconsidered; I usually enjoy a night of revelry and I refused to let him take that away from me. I landed on a dress that encapsulated that mood perfectly. A sequin micro mini with exaggerated sleeves and a plunging neckline. It was just the boost I needed to feel like myself again. It's the same energy Tina Turner emanated when she stepped out in 1986 after leaving her abusive marriage. She donned a skin-tight leather Azzedine Alaïa gown with four cutouts down the side, her hair in a blonde spiky mullet. Megan Thee Stallion had a similar air of confidence as she posed in a red Outcast cutout dress at her Hot Girl Summer Swimwear fashion show — fresh off a breakup with NBA player Klay Thompson. Dressing for revenge is less about retaliation, and more a bold declaration of self-love. It's putting on a brave face and a cutout dress or a bra and maxi skirt — and letting the world know that what happened to you didn't break you and will not define you. Keep scrolling to glean your own confidence from the best celebrity revenge moments of all time, from Princess Diana to Ciara Miller. Princess Diana wore the original revenge dress to a Vanity Fair party at the Serpentine Gallery, at the same time her then-husband Prince Charles publicly admitted to cheating on her with Queen Consort Camilla Parker-Bowles. After divorcing her abusive husband Ike Turner, the late Tina Turner embraced a new era of revenge dressing, choosing bold and daring dresses like this leather cutout style from Azzedine Alaïa (pictured). Mariah Carey celebrated her emancipation from a toxic relationship with music executive Tommy Mottola with a whole new look. Free from her controlling ex-husband, she hit the red carpet circa 1998 in a hip-high-slit skirt and bra top. Shakira appeared to pay homage to the original revenge dress in her look at the 2022 Cannes Film Festival. Following news that her long-term boyfriend, Gerard Pique, was having an affair, the "TQG" singer posed in a gown with the same plunging neckline and black color as Princess Diana's look. For a modern twist, Shakira added sheer gloves, strappy sandals, and a high leg slit. While her fiancé, soccer player Sebastian Lletget, was posting a cheating admission on Instagram, Becky G was living her best life at the iHeartRadio Music Awards. She twirled in a sheer lace gown with a plunging neckline and open shoulders. The Bravo universe was shaken to its core when news dropped that "Vanderpump Rules" star Tom Sandoval cheated on fan-favorite Ariana Madix with her friend and castmate Raquel Welch. In the mid-season trailer, Madix famously told Sandoval, "[I want] for you to die," and she came to the reunion dressed to kill . The "Something About Her" co-owner wore a red-hot top and skirt from Mônot, with chest, ab, and waist cutouts on full display. Outcast Celine Mini Dress ($75) Megan Thee Stallion had a head-turning fashion moment at Miami Swim Week, backstage at her own Hot Girl Summer swimwear show. Fresh from a breakup where she revealed she'd been cheated on by NBA player Klay Thompson, she wowed in a red cutout mini that's still available to shop. Hot girl summer, indeed. Ciara Miller continues to handle the fallout from #Scamanda with elegance and grace, and her revenge look for the "Summer House" season 10 reunion is just the latest example. Wearing a bra top and low-rise maxi skirt with draping throughout, Miller's outfit made it clear that she's a force to be reckoned with and no one — least of all, a friend and ex who'd betray her for a casual hookup — will slow her down. — Additional reporting by Naomi Parris Jessica C.
