article_title: Ciara Miller and the Art of Dressing for Revenge
sub_title: See all the celebrities who have worn a revenge dress through the years, from Princess Diana to Ciara Miller on "Summer House."
article_content: Princess Diana in an off-shoulder minidress when Prince Charles went public with his affair. Mariah Carey in a hip-high slit after leaving a tumultuous marriage. Ariana Madix in a fiery-red cutout set in the wake of Scandoval , when she caught her longterm boyfriend Tom Sandoval cheating with her friend Raquel Leviss. And most recently, Ciara Miller in a revenge bra and maxi skirt look to film the "Summer House" ten reunion after Scamanda , when Miller's best friend Amanda Batula secretly started dating her on-again, off-again ex-boyfriend West Wilson. The revenge look isn't a new phenomenon, but it remains at the forefront of everyone's minds. Inspired by the black mini worn by the Princess of Wales in the 1990s, the modern revenge look is fashion at its most communicative. It's bold, fitted in silhouette, and red or black or cream in color. It boasts plunging necklines and conspicuous cutouts, high splits and open backs. It's a comeback story, rendered sartorially. Despite the revenge look's enduring legacy, I always felt uneasy about it. How vengeful is a sultry outfit anyway? A better act of revenge would be, well, cheating back, as Chloe Bailey sings . What's more, the concept of "revenge dressing" frames a woman's wardrobe and appearance as her primary weapons of power. What about revenge accomplishments? Revenge art? Revenge careers? Why is it that — after a woman's been wronged — the statement that really makes an impact revolves around how she looks? I'm also not sold on the idea of dressing with the offending party in mind. Fashion is such a personal, intimate act for me; I get dressed based on my mood, my desires, my social calendar for the week. I don't want that process to be hijacked by someone else, let alone someone who caused me harm. [T]here's something empowering about the revenge dress. It speaks to the confidence of a woman who knows that her value goes far beyond how she was treated. But I learned — through experience — that there's something empowering about the revenge dress. It speaks to the confidence of a woman who knows that her value goes far beyond how she was treated. My revenge dress story is pretty typical. Several years ago, pre-pandemic, I found myself on the verge of a break up. We had been so in sync; we had amazing chemistry; we saw a future together with kids, pets, and even a few business ventures. But when I signed into his Netflix account, of all things, I saw a newly-created profile bearing another woman's name — someone he'd visited once to help her fix a broken water pipe, allegedly. I inquired about it, and our relationship quickly unraveled from there. He was belligerent and I was crushed. And the New Year's Eve party invite I had accepted a few days prior hung in the balance. I was not in the mood to dress up and be around people. But then I reconsidered; I usually enjoy a night of revelry and I refused to let him take that away from me. I landed on a dress that encapsulated that mood perfectly. A sequin micro mini with exaggerated sleeves and a plunging neckline. It was just the boost I needed to feel like myself again. It's the same energy Tina Turner emanated when she stepped out in 1986 after leaving her abusive marriage. She donned a skin-tight leather Azzedine Alaïa gown with four cutouts down the side, her hair in a blonde spiky mullet. Megan Thee Stallion had a similar air of confidence as she posed in a red Outcast cutout dress at her Hot Girl Summer Swimwear fashion show — fresh off a breakup with NBA player Klay Thompson. Dressing for revenge is less about retaliation, and more a bold declaration of self-love. It's putting on a brave face and a cutout dress or a bra and maxi skirt — and letting the world know that what happened to you didn't break you and will not define you. Keep scrolling to glean your own confidence from the best celebrity revenge moments of all time, from Princess Diana to Ciara Miller. Princess Diana wore the original revenge dress to a Vanity Fair party at the Serpentine Gallery, at the same time her then-husband Prince Charles publicly admitted to cheating on her with Queen Consort Camilla Parker-Bowles. After divorcing her abusive husband Ike Turner, the late Tina Turner embraced a new era of revenge dressing, choosing bold and daring dresses like this leather cutout style from Azzedine Alaïa (pictured). Mariah Carey celebrated her emancipation from a toxic relationship with music executive Tommy Mottola with a whole new look. Free from her controlling ex-husband, she hit the red carpet circa 1998 in a hip-high-slit skirt and bra top. Shakira appeared to pay homage to the original revenge dress in her look at the 2022 Cannes Film Festival. Following news that her long-term boyfriend, Gerard Pique, was having an affair, the "TQG" singer posed in a gown with the same plunging neckline and black color as Princess Diana's look. For a modern twist, Shakira added sheer gloves, strappy sandals, and a high leg slit. While her fiancé, soccer player Sebastian Lletget, was posting a cheating admission on Instagram, Becky G was living her best life at the iHeartRadio Music Awards. She twirled in a sheer lace gown with a plunging neckline and open shoulders. The Bravo universe was shaken to its core when news dropped that "Vanderpump Rules" star Tom Sandoval cheated on fan-favorite Ariana Madix with her friend and castmate Raquel Welch. In the mid-season trailer, Madix famously told Sandoval, "[I want] for you to die," and she came to the reunion dressed to kill . The "Something About Her" co-owner wore a red-hot top and skirt from Mônot, with chest, ab, and waist cutouts on full display. article_content: Taylor Swift has had many a style evolution — and fans have breathlessly followed each one. Over the course of her nearly 20-year career, Swift's fashion has run the gamut from denim exercise dresses to sultry evening dresses and embellished bodysuits to date-night corsets . As far as inspiration, the 35-year-old star looks to a variety of muses, including preppy schoolgirls and early-aughts teens. When Swift finds her uniform of sorts, she sticks with it. During Swift's award-winning Eras Tour, fans recreated past aesthetics with their concert outfits . Drawing from the most iconic Swift outfits, attendees embraced the snake theme as a nod to her "Reputation" era, or gold sequins to reference her "Midnights" era . Meanwhile, Swift's own looks for star-studded events, like the VMAs or the Met Gala, are decidedly more high end. Take her Oscar de la Renta dress at the 2022 MTV VMAs , which is runway ready and glamorous, like most of Swift's red carpet outfits. sub_title: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce tied the knot on Friday, July 3 at Madison Square Garden. Here are the celebrity guests who made our best dressed list.
article_content: Congratulations are in order for Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce after they tied the knot on Friday, July 3 at Madison Square Garden. The star-studded event included Hollywood stars, NFL players, music legends, and, of course, Swift's inner circle. While the designer was unaware where she would be wearing the dress when her team requested it, he still thought the choice fit the setting. "I think the silhouette and dramatic volume bring a level of formality befitting for such a momentous occasion," he tells Popsugar. "The high-low hemline and subdued color keep it light and appropriate for a wedding guest." She accessorized the look with a Carolina Herrera Karlita Bow Satin Clutch ($1,490) and Jimmy Choo Max 150 Black Satin Sandals ($1,050). Recreate Lopez's look with these similar dress styles: ASTR the Label Vinya Cotton Dress ($70, originally $158), Almond Muse Francesca Dress ($80, originally $160), Alex & Sophia Juniors' Scoop Neck Shirred Midi Dress ($119), L'Academie Sidney Gown ($288), and Jenny Yoo Shelby Dress ($295). Taylor Swift's life-long best friend Abigail Anderson was in her enchanted era for Friday's nuptials. Pretty in pink, Gigi Hadid showed up with a romantic rose dress from Wiederhoeft's Spring/Summer 2025 collection. Selena Gomez's Oscar de la Renta gown captured the perfect level of sparkle. Her pop of red lipstick, which might have been a subtle nod to Swift's favorite lip color . article_title: Get Taylor Swift's H&M Courtside Tank Look Starting at $11
sub_title: See some of Taylor Swift's best fashion outfits over the years, and shop a few similar pieces to get her style for yourself.
article_content: Taylor Swift has had many a style evolution — and fans have breathlessly followed each one. When the "Bejeweled" singer initially stepped out in boho dresses and cowboy boots, Swifties immediately began doing the same. And when she entered her preppy early-aughts-inspired era in knee socks and miniskirts, her supporters followed suit. Over the course of her nearly 20-year career, Swift's fashion has run the gamut from denim exercise dresses to sultry evening dresses and embellished bodysuits to date-night corsets . As far as inspiration, the 35-year-old star looks to a variety of muses, including preppy schoolgirls and early-aughts teens. When Swift finds her uniform of sorts, she sticks with it. And the acclaimed songwriter is famous for marrying those fashion moments to eras in her career, which also coincide with her albums — the newest of which is "The Life of A Showgirl," which came out October 3. During Swift's award-winning Eras Tour, fans recreated past aesthetics with their concert outfits . Drawing from the most iconic Swift outfits, attendees embraced the snake theme as a nod to her "Reputation" era, or gold sequins to reference her "Midnights" era . Meanwhile, Swift's own looks for star-studded events, like the VMAs or the Met Gala, are decidedly more high end. Take her Oscar de la Renta dress at the 2022 MTV VMAs , which is runway ready and glamorous, like most of Swift's red carpet outfits. It helps that the superstar loves to wear accessible brands — even when they collaborate with high-end designers. That was the case with her latest look, sitting courtside with Travis Kelce at the NBA Eastern Conference Finals. Swift's tank top was part of the highly-coveted H&M collab with Stella McCartney. While some of the collection is already sold out, there is still some inventory to sift through. Ahead, shop Swift's latest courtside style, then take a walk down memory lane with her fashion moments over the years. While there might have been basketball finals going on, all eyes were on Swift sitting courtside with fiancé Travis Kelce. Her version of sporty-chic attire? Head-to-toe Stella McCartney, featuring a top from the designer's latest collab with H&M. Instead of a basic ribbed tank top, the scoop neck is embellished with a chunky silver chain for a built-in statement. If you're looking for something similar to the sold-out top , these styles capture the same aesthetic: The Noli Shop Millie Knit Tank ($128); All Saints Lucy Tank Top ($129); Generation Love Mabel Chain Trim Top ($148); and Forever 21 Plus Size Seamless Chain-Trim Tank ($11, originally $20). The only item from Swift's all-black outfit that wasn't Louis Vuitton on date-night with fiancé Travis Kelce? Her Fleur du Mal rose lace tights. With the addition of some gold jewelry courtesy of Cartier, 100 Ways, and, of course, her engagement ring , the stockings brought texture and dimension to an otherwise chic and neutral look. Swift's black off-shoulder bodysuit from Alaïa, worn on Nov. 11 in New York City, features subtle ribbing and a snap-button closure. She teamed it with gray Stella McCartney wool slacks, Jimmy Choo x Jean Paul Gaultier pumps, the Stella McCartney Ryder bag, and jewelry, including her engagement ring and complementary pieces from Louis Vuitton and Audry Rose. While the outfit costs a pretty penny, Swift has proven a black sculpting bodysuit is a timeless staple, having worn a similar style with a plaid miniskirt exactly one year prior. Taylor Swift steps out in NYC in the perfect preppy Autumn outfit, wearing a Stella McCartney polo shirt and knee-high boots from Prada. Taylor Swift nods to the release of "1989 (Taylor's Version)" with Fall colors: a brown Acne Studios corduroy skirt, Madewell leather blazer, and Gianvito Rossi ankle boots. Taylor Swift wowed at "Taylor Swift: The Eras Tour" concert movie world premiere in a strapless cutout gown from Oscar de la Renta. She complemented the look with strappy sandals, a curly bob, and her signature red lip. At the 2023 Grammy Awards, Taylor Swift hit the red carpet in a navy crop top and skirt designed by Roberto Cavalli and oversize statement earrings and rings from Lorraine Schwartz. Taylor Swift rocked a take on the naked dress at the 2022 MTV VMAs in an Oscar de la Renta chain-link minidress that was totally sheer, save for the allover embellishment. Her jewelry was by Lorraine Schwartz, and her heels were from Christian Louboutin. Taylor Swift borrowed from the boys with a Max Mara suiting look in NYC in June 2022, choosing to wear a waistcoat with nothing underneath. She wore it with Vrai earrings and rings, along with Prada pumps. For the 2021 Grammy Awards, Swift went for a spring theme, slipping into a gorgeous embroidered floral dress from Oscar de la Renta. She paired the look with pink ankle-tie heels from Christian Louboutin and Cathy Waterman jewelry. Taylor Swift channeled a disco ball at the 2018 AMAs, dressed head to toe in Balmain with a metallic minidress and thigh-high boots, styled with Lorraine Schwartz jewelry. Taylor Swift's summertime take on the Canadian tuxedo consisted of a Madewell denim crop top and black denim Ksubi shorts. She kept it casual with a pair of white sneakers from Golden Goose, Jimmy Choo sunglasses, and a Christian Louboutin backpack slung over one shoulder. Going for a futuristic look for the Met Gala that she hosted in 2016, Swift slipped into a cutout metallic minidress from Louis Vuitton with black heels that crisscrossed their way all the way to her knees. Her jewelry was designed by Eva Fehren, Massia Cielo, and Borgioni. Taylor Swift went for full-blown color at the 2016 Grammy Awards, dressed in a Versace crop top and high-waisted ball skirt with an up-to-there slit that showed off the built-in briefs underneath. On one hand were two rings from Ofira, while the rest of her jewelry was designed by Lorraine Schwartz. Taking her white kitten for a stroll in NYC, Swift went for a schoolgirl-inspired look, slipping into a plaid miniskirt from RD Style, a white top from Free People, crocheted knee socks from Tabbisocks, and pumps from & Other Stories. Taylor Swift loves a matching set, and she rocked a sheer striped floral miniskirt and cropped tee from H&M with Elie Saab heels in New York City in August 2014. In the mid-2010s, Taylor Swift loved a Reformation moment, and this look was no exception. In NYC in July 2014, she wore a shorts romper from the brand with Gucci pumps and a neutral handbag. Taylor Swift was ladylike with a twist while in New York City in July 2017, wearing a polka-dot slit pencil skirt and matching crop top, both from Reformation. On her feet were Pikolinos heels, and she carried a bag from Kate Spade. A longtime Met Gala attendee, Taylor Swift leaned into the couture angle for her Charles James celebratory evening in 2014, wearing a custom Oscar de la Renta gown, Lorraine Schwartz jewelry, and Christian Louboutin heels. In a posh princess moment, Taylor Swift hit the red carpet at the 2007 CMT Music Awards in a BCBG Max Azria sequined tulle dress. At the 2006 Academy of Country Music Awards, Swift leaned into her bohemian Southern roots with a printed handkerchief halter dress from BCBG Max Azria, styled with cowboy boots. — Additional reporting by Naomi Parris, Sarah Wasilak, Balim Tezel, and Adelaide Giesey Avery Matera is a PS contributor who covers all things fashion. article_content: Every year, Essence Festival brings out some of the biggest names in entertainment to the great city of New Orleans for a weekend celebrating Black music, culture, and revelry. Hosted near the July 4 holiday, the landmark event boasts nightly concerts at the Superdome — including Prince in 2014, Janet Jackson in 2022, and Usher in 2024 — as well as a packed schedule of events during the day like the "Black Excellence" brunch and Prime Video "Essence of Leading Ladies" soiree. And celebrities come dressed in their finest summer-ready outfits for the occasion. Keeping the city's scorching temperatures and soaring humidity in mind, stars manage to choose practical looks without sacrificing style. There are plenty of warm-weather-friendly trends on display, from cutouts to micro minis. Embellished one-shoulder dresses, polished skirt suits, and colorful rompers are also in heavy demand at the stylish festival. For concerts, artists think outside the box, choosing bold designs that will make a memorable impact. From a studded bra-and-chaps set to a nude bodysuit covered in glittering gold embellishment, there's no telling what theatrical look you'll witness on the Essence Festival stage. For the 2026 Essence Festival, artists brought their sartorial A-game. Keke Palmer graced the stage to host a live version of her podcast in a gorgeous metallic corset. Brandy looked stunning for her headlining concert at the Superdome wearing a black and white printed Christian Siriano gown. Teyana Taylor wowed at Essence Black Women in Hollywood wearing a printed floral gown that would work perfectly for a summer garden wedding. article_title: Ciara Miller and the Art of Dressing for Revenge
sub_title: See all the celebrities who have worn a revenge dress through the years, from Princess Diana to Ciara Miller on "Summer House."
article_content: Princess Diana in an off-shoulder minidress when Prince Charles went public with his affair. Mariah Carey in a hip-high slit after leaving a tumultuous marriage. Ariana Madix in a fiery-red cutout set in the wake of Scandoval , when she caught her longterm boyfriend Tom Sandoval cheating with her friend Raquel Leviss. And most recently, Ciara Miller in a revenge bra and maxi skirt look to film the "Summer House" ten reunion after Scamanda , when Miller's best friend Amanda Batula secretly started dating her on-again, off-again ex-boyfriend West Wilson. The revenge look isn't a new phenomenon, but it remains at the forefront of everyone's minds. Inspired by the black mini worn by the Princess of Wales in the 1990s, the modern revenge look is fashion at its most communicative. It's bold, fitted in silhouette, and red or black or cream in color. It boasts plunging necklines and conspicuous cutouts, high splits and open backs. It's a comeback story, rendered sartorially. Despite the revenge look's enduring legacy, I always felt uneasy about it. How vengeful is a sultry outfit anyway? A better act of revenge would be, well, cheating back, as Chloe Bailey sings . What's more, the concept of "revenge dressing" frames a woman's wardrobe and appearance as her primary weapons of power. What about revenge accomplishments? Revenge art? Revenge careers? Why is it that — after a woman's been wronged — the statement that really makes an impact revolves around how she looks? I'm also not sold on the idea of dressing with the offending party in mind. Fashion is such a personal, intimate act for me; I get dressed based on my mood, my desires, my social calendar for the week. I don't want that process to be hijacked by someone else, let alone someone who caused me harm. [T]here's something empowering about the revenge dress. It speaks to the confidence of a woman who knows that her value goes far beyond how she was treated. But I learned — through experience — that there's something empowering about the revenge dress. It speaks to the confidence of a woman who knows that her value goes far beyond how she was treated. My revenge dress story is pretty typical. Several years ago, pre-pandemic, I found myself on the verge of a break up. We had been so in sync; we had amazing chemistry; we saw a future together with kids, pets, and even a few business ventures. But when I signed into his Netflix account, of all things, I saw a newly-created profile bearing another woman's name — someone he'd visited once to help her fix a broken water pipe, allegedly. I inquired about it, and our relationship quickly unraveled from there. He was belligerent and I was crushed. And the New Year's Eve party invite I had accepted a few days prior hung in the balance. I was not in the mood to dress up and be around people. But then I reconsidered; I usually enjoy a night of revelry and I refused to let him take that away from me. I landed on a dress that encapsulated that mood perfectly. A sequin micro mini with exaggerated sleeves and a plunging neckline. It was just the boost I needed to feel like myself again. It's the same energy Tina Turner emanated when she stepped out in 1986 after leaving her abusive marriage. She donned a skin-tight leather Azzedine Alaïa gown with four cutouts down the side, her hair in a blonde spiky mullet. Megan Thee Stallion had a similar air of confidence as she posed in a red Outcast cutout dress at her Hot Girl Summer Swimwear fashion show — fresh off a breakup with NBA player Klay Thompson. Dressing for revenge is less about retaliation, and more a bold declaration of self-love. It's putting on a brave face and a cutout dress or a bra and maxi skirt — and letting the world know that what happened to you didn't break you and will not define you. Keep scrolling to glean your own confidence from the best celebrity revenge moments of all time, from Princess Diana to Ciara Miller. Princess Diana wore the original revenge dress to a Vanity Fair party at the Serpentine Gallery, at the same time her then-husband Prince Charles publicly admitted to cheating on her with Queen Consort Camilla Parker-Bowles. After divorcing her abusive husband Ike Turner, the late Tina Turner embraced a new era of revenge dressing, choosing bold and daring dresses like this leather cutout style from Azzedine Alaïa (pictured). Mariah Carey celebrated her emancipation from a toxic relationship with music executive Tommy Mottola with a whole new look. Free from her controlling ex-husband, she hit the red carpet circa 1998 in a hip-high-slit skirt and bra top. Shakira appeared to pay homage to the original revenge dress in her look at the 2022 Cannes Film Festival. Following news that her long-term boyfriend, Gerard Pique, was having an affair, the "TQG" singer posed in a gown with the same plunging neckline and black color as Princess Diana's look. For a modern twist, Shakira added sheer gloves, strappy sandals, and a high leg slit. While her fiancé, soccer player Sebastian Lletget, was posting a cheating admission on Instagram, Becky G was living her best life at the iHeartRadio Music Awards. She twirled in a sheer lace gown with a plunging neckline and open shoulders. The Bravo universe was shaken to its core when news dropped that "Vanderpump Rules" star Tom Sandoval cheated on fan-favorite Ariana Madix with her friend and castmate Raquel Welch. In the mid-season trailer, Madix famously told Sandoval, "[I want] for you to die," and she came to the reunion dressed to kill . The "Something About Her" co-owner wore a red-hot top and skirt from Mônot, with chest, ab, and waist cutouts on full display. Outcast Celine Mini Dress ($75) Megan Thee Stallion had a head-turning fashion moment at Miami Swim Week, backstage at her own Hot Girl Summer swimwear show. Fresh from a breakup where she revealed she'd been cheated on by NBA player Klay Thompson, she wowed in a red cutout mini that's still available to shop. Hot girl summer, indeed. Ciara Miller continues to handle the fallout from #Scamanda with elegance and grace, and her revenge look for the "Summer House" season 10 reunion is just the latest example. Wearing a bra top and low-rise maxi skirt with draping throughout, Miller's outfit made it clear that she's a force to be reckoned with and no one — least of all, a friend and ex who'd betray her for a casual hookup — will slow her down. — Additional reporting by Naomi Parris Jessica C. article_content: Taylor Swift has had many a style evolution — and fans have breathlessly followed each one. When the "Bejeweled" singer initially stepped out in boho dresses and cowboy boots, Swifties immediately began doing the same. And when she entered her preppy early-aughts-inspired era in knee socks and miniskirts, her supporters followed suit. Over the course of her nearly 20-year career, Swift's fashion has run the gamut from denim exercise dresses to sultry evening dresses and embellished bodysuits to date-night corsets . As far as inspiration, the 35-year-old star looks to a variety of muses, including preppy schoolgirls and early-aughts teens. When Swift finds her uniform of sorts, she sticks with it. And the acclaimed songwriter is famous for marrying those fashion moments to eras in her career, which also coincide with her albums — the newest of which is "The Life of A Showgirl," which came out October 3. During Swift's award-winning Eras Tour, fans recreated past aesthetics with their concert outfits . Drawing from the most iconic Swift outfits, attendees embraced the snake theme as a nod to her "Reputation" era, or gold sequins to reference her "Midnights" era . Meanwhile, Swift's own looks for star-studded events, like the VMAs or the Met Gala, are decidedly more high end. Take her Oscar de la Renta dress at the 2022 MTV VMAs , which is runway ready and glamorous, like most of Swift's red carpet outfits. It helps that the superstar loves to wear accessible brands — even when they collaborate with high-end designers. That was the case with her latest look, sitting courtside with Travis Kelce at the NBA Eastern Conference Finals. Swift's tank top was part of the highly-coveted H&M collab with Stella McCartney. While some of the collection is already sold out, there is still some inventory to sift through. Ahead, shop Swift's latest courtside style, then take a walk down memory lane with her fashion moments over the years. article_content: Every year, Essence Festival brings out some of the biggest names in entertainment to the great city of New Orleans for a weekend celebrating Black music, culture, and revelry. Hosted near the July 4 holiday, the landmark event boasts nightly concerts at the Superdome — including Prince in 2014, Janet Jackson in 2022, and Usher in 2024 — as well as a packed schedule of events during the day like the "Black Excellence" brunch and Prime Video "Essence of Leading Ladies" soiree. And celebrities come dressed in their finest summer-ready outfits for the occasion. Keeping the city's scorching temperatures and soaring humidity in mind, stars manage to choose practical looks without sacrificing style. There are plenty of warm-weather-friendly trends on display, from cutouts to micro minis. Embellished one-shoulder dresses, polished skirt suits, and colorful rompers are also in heavy demand at the stylish festival. article_title: Ciara Miller and the Art of Dressing for Revenge
sub_title: See all the celebrities who have worn a revenge dress through the years, from Princess Diana to Ciara Miller on "Summer House."
article_content: Princess Diana in an off-shoulder minidress when Prince Charles went public with his affair. Mariah Carey in a hip-high slit after leaving a tumultuous marriage. Ariana Madix in a fiery-red cutout set in the wake of Scandoval , when she caught her longterm boyfriend Tom Sandoval cheating with her friend Raquel Leviss. And most recently, Ciara Miller in a revenge bra and maxi skirt look to film the "Summer House" ten reunion after Scamanda , when Miller's best friend Amanda Batula secretly started dating her on-again, off-again ex-boyfriend West Wilson. The revenge look isn't a new phenomenon, but it remains at the forefront of everyone's minds. Inspired by the black mini worn by the Princess of Wales in the 1990s, the modern revenge look is fashion at its most communicative. It's bold, fitted in silhouette, and red or black or cream in color. It boasts plunging necklines and conspicuous cutouts, high splits and open backs. It's a comeback story, rendered sartorially. Despite the revenge look's enduring legacy, I always felt uneasy about it. How vengeful is a sultry outfit anyway? A better act of revenge would be, well, cheating back, as Chloe Bailey sings . What's more, the concept of "revenge dressing" frames a woman's wardrobe and appearance as her primary weapons of power. What about revenge accomplishments? Revenge art? Revenge careers? Why is it that — after a woman's been wronged — the statement that really makes an impact revolves around how she looks? I'm also not sold on the idea of dressing with the offending party in mind. Fashion is such a personal, intimate act for me; I get dressed based on my mood, my desires, my social calendar for the week. I don't want that process to be hijacked by someone else, let alone someone who caused me harm. [T]here's something empowering about the revenge dress. It speaks to the confidence of a woman who knows that her value goes far beyond how she was treated. But I learned — through experience — that there's something empowering about the revenge dress. It speaks to the confidence of a woman who knows that her value goes far beyond how she was treated. My revenge dress story is pretty typical. Several years ago, pre-pandemic, I found myself on the verge of a break up. We had been so in sync; we had amazing chemistry; we saw a future together with kids, pets, and even a few business ventures. But when I signed into his Netflix account, of all things, I saw a newly-created profile bearing another woman's name — someone he'd visited once to help her fix a broken water pipe, allegedly. I inquired about it, and our relationship quickly unraveled from there. He was belligerent and I was crushed. And the New Year's Eve party invite I had accepted a few days prior hung in the balance. I was not in the mood to dress up and be around people. But then I reconsidered; I usually enjoy a night of revelry and I refused to let him take that away from me. I landed on a dress that encapsulated that mood perfectly. A sequin micro mini with exaggerated sleeves and a plunging neckline. It was just the boost I needed to feel like myself again. It's the same energy Tina Turner emanated when she stepped out in 1986 after leaving her abusive marriage. She donned a skin-tight leather Azzedine Alaïa gown with four cutouts down the side, her hair in a blonde spiky mullet. Megan Thee Stallion had a similar air of confidence as she posed in a red Outcast cutout dress at her Hot Girl Summer Swimwear fashion show — fresh off a breakup with NBA player Klay Thompson. Dressing for revenge is less about retaliation, and more a bold declaration of self-love. It's putting on a brave face and a cutout dress or a bra and maxi skirt — and letting the world know that what happened to you didn't break you and will not define you. Keep scrolling to glean your own confidence from the best celebrity revenge moments of all time, from Princess Diana to Ciara Miller. Princess Diana wore the original revenge dress to a Vanity Fair party at the Serpentine Gallery, at the same time her then-husband Prince Charles publicly admitted to cheating on her with Queen Consort Camilla Parker-Bowles. After divorcing her abusive husband Ike Turner, the late Tina Turner embraced a new era of revenge dressing, choosing bold and daring dresses like this leather cutout style from Azzedine Alaïa (pictured). Mariah Carey celebrated her emancipation from a toxic relationship with music executive Tommy Mottola with a whole new look. Free from her controlling ex-husband, she hit the red carpet circa 1998 in a hip-high-slit skirt and bra top. Shakira appeared to pay homage to the original revenge dress in her look at the 2022 Cannes Film Festival. Following news that her long-term boyfriend, Gerard Pique, was having an affair, the "TQG" singer posed in a gown with the same plunging neckline and black color as Princess Diana's look. For a modern twist, Shakira added sheer gloves, strappy sandals, and a high leg slit. While her fiancé, soccer player Sebastian Lletget, was posting a cheating admission on Instagram, Becky G was living her best life at the iHeartRadio Music Awards. She twirled in a sheer lace gown with a plunging neckline and open shoulders. The Bravo universe was shaken to its core when news dropped that "Vanderpump Rules" star Tom Sandoval cheated on fan-favorite Ariana Madix with her friend and castmate Raquel Welch. In the mid-season trailer, Madix famously told Sandoval, "[I want] for you to die," and she came to the reunion dressed to kill . The "Something About Her" co-owner wore a red-hot top and skirt from Mônot, with chest, ab, and waist cutouts on full display. Outcast Celine Mini Dress ($75) Megan Thee Stallion had a head-turning fashion moment at Miami Swim Week, backstage at her own Hot Girl Summer swimwear show. Fresh from a breakup where she revealed she'd been cheated on by NBA player Klay Thompson, she wowed in a red cutout mini that's still available to shop. Hot girl summer, indeed. Ciara Miller continues to handle the fallout from #Scamanda with elegance and grace, and her revenge look for the "Summer House" season 10 reunion is just the latest example. Wearing a bra top and low-rise maxi skirt with draping throughout, Miller's outfit made it clear that she's a force to be reckoned with and no one — least of all, a friend and ex who'd betray her for a casual hookup — will slow her down. — Additional reporting by Naomi Parris Jessica C. article_content: Taylor Swift has had many a style evolution — and fans have breathlessly followed each one. When the "Bejeweled" singer initially stepped out in boho dresses and cowboy boots, Swifties immediately began doing the same. And when she entered her preppy early-aughts-inspired era in knee socks and miniskirts, her supporters followed suit. Over the course of her nearly 20-year career, Swift's fashion has run the gamut from denim exercise dresses to sultry evening dresses and embellished bodysuits to date-night corsets . As far as inspiration, the 35-year-old star looks to a variety of muses, including preppy schoolgirls and early-aughts teens. When Swift finds her uniform of sorts, she sticks with it. And the acclaimed songwriter is famous for marrying those fashion moments to eras in her career, which also coincide with her albums — the newest of which is "The Life of A Showgirl," which came out October 3. During Swift's award-winning Eras Tour, fans recreated past aesthetics with their concert outfits . Drawing from the most iconic Swift outfits, attendees embraced the snake theme as a nod to her "Reputation" era, or gold sequins to reference her "Midnights" era . Meanwhile, Swift's own looks for star-studded events, like the VMAs or the Met Gala, are decidedly more high end. Take her Oscar de la Renta dress at the 2022 MTV VMAs , which is runway ready and glamorous, like most of Swift's red carpet outfits. It helps that the superstar loves to wear accessible brands — even when they collaborate with high-end designers. That was the case with her latest look, sitting courtside with Travis Kelce at the NBA Eastern Conference Finals. Swift's tank top was part of the highly-coveted H&M collab with Stella McCartney. While some of the collection is already sold out, there is still some inventory to sift through. Ahead, shop Swift's latest courtside style, then take a walk down memory lane with her fashion moments over the years. She complemented the look with strappy sandals, a curly bob, and her signature red lip. At the 2023 Grammy Awards, Taylor Swift hit the red carpet in a navy crop top and skirt designed by Roberto Cavalli and oversize statement earrings and rings from Lorraine Schwartz. Taylor Swift rocked a take on the naked dress at the 2022 MTV VMAs in an Oscar de la Renta chain-link minidress that was totally sheer, save for the allover embellishment. Her jewelry was by Lorraine Schwartz, and her heels were from Christian Louboutin. Taylor Swift borrowed from the boys with a Max Mara suiting look in NYC in June 2022, choosing to wear a waistcoat with nothing underneath. She wore it with Vrai earrings and rings, along with Prada pumps. For the 2021 Grammy Awards, Swift went for a spring theme, slipping into a gorgeous embroidered floral dress from Oscar de la Renta. She paired the look with pink ankle-tie heels from Christian Louboutin and Cathy Waterman jewelry. Taylor Swift channeled a disco ball at the 2018 AMAs, dressed head to toe in Balmain with a metallic minidress and thigh-high boots, styled with Lorraine Schwartz jewelry. Taylor Swift's summertime take on the Canadian tuxedo consisted of a Madewell denim crop top and black denim Ksubi shorts. She kept it casual with a pair of white sneakers from Golden Goose, Jimmy Choo sunglasses, and a Christian Louboutin backpack slung over one shoulder. Going for a futuristic look for the Met Gala that she hosted in 2016, Swift slipped into a cutout metallic minidress from Louis Vuitton with black heels that crisscrossed their way all the way to her knees. Her jewelry was designed by Eva Fehren, Massia Cielo, and Borgioni. Taylor Swift went for full-blown color at the 2016 Grammy Awards, dressed in a Versace crop top and high-waisted ball skirt with an up-to-there slit that showed off the built-in briefs underneath. article_title: Ciara Miller and the Art of Dressing for Revenge
sub_title: See all the celebrities who have worn a revenge dress through the years, from Princess Diana to Ciara Miller on "Summer House."
article_content: Princess Diana in an off-shoulder minidress when Prince Charles went public with his affair. Mariah Carey in a hip-high slit after leaving a tumultuous marriage. Ariana Madix in a fiery-red cutout set in the wake of Scandoval , when she caught her longterm boyfriend Tom Sandoval cheating with her friend Raquel Leviss. And most recently, Ciara Miller in a revenge bra and maxi skirt look to film the "Summer House" ten reunion after Scamanda , when Miller's best friend Amanda Batula secretly started dating her on-again, off-again ex-boyfriend West Wilson. The revenge look isn't a new phenomenon, but it remains at the forefront of everyone's minds. Inspired by the black mini worn by the Princess of Wales in the 1990s, the modern revenge look is fashion at its most communicative. It's bold, fitted in silhouette, and red or black or cream in color. It boasts plunging necklines and conspicuous cutouts, high splits and open backs. It's a comeback story, rendered sartorially. Despite the revenge look's enduring legacy, I always felt uneasy about it. How vengeful is a sultry outfit anyway? A better act of revenge would be, well, cheating back, as Chloe Bailey sings . What's more, the concept of "revenge dressing" frames a woman's wardrobe and appearance as her primary weapons of power. What about revenge accomplishments? Revenge art? Revenge careers? Why is it that — after a woman's been wronged — the statement that really makes an impact revolves around how she looks? I'm also not sold on the idea of dressing with the offending party in mind. Fashion is such a personal, intimate act for me; I get dressed based on my mood, my desires, my social calendar for the week. I don't want that process to be hijacked by someone else, let alone someone who caused me harm. [T]here's something empowering about the revenge dress. It speaks to the confidence of a woman who knows that her value goes far beyond how she was treated. But I learned — through experience — that there's something empowering about the revenge dress. It speaks to the confidence of a woman who knows that her value goes far beyond how she was treated. My revenge dress story is pretty typical. Several years ago, pre-pandemic, I found myself on the verge of a break up. We had been so in sync; we had amazing chemistry; we saw a future together with kids, pets, and even a few business ventures. But when I signed into his Netflix account, of all things, I saw a newly-created profile bearing another woman's name — someone he'd visited once to help her fix a broken water pipe, allegedly. I inquired about it, and our relationship quickly unraveled from there. He was belligerent and I was crushed. And the New Year's Eve party invite I had accepted a few days prior hung in the balance. I was not in the mood to dress up and be around people. But then I reconsidered; I usually enjoy a night of revelry and I refused to let him take that away from me. I landed on a dress that encapsulated that mood perfectly. A sequin micro mini with exaggerated sleeves and a plunging neckline. It was just the boost I needed to feel like myself again. It's the same energy Tina Turner emanated when she stepped out in 1986 after leaving her abusive marriage. She donned a skin-tight leather Azzedine Alaïa gown with four cutouts down the side, her hair in a blonde spiky mullet. Megan Thee Stallion had a similar air of confidence as she posed in a red Outcast cutout dress at her Hot Girl Summer Swimwear fashion show — fresh off a breakup with NBA player Klay Thompson. Dressing for revenge is less about retaliation, and more a bold declaration of self-love. It's putting on a brave face and a cutout dress or a bra and maxi skirt — and letting the world know that what happened to you didn't break you and will not define you. Keep scrolling to glean your own confidence from the best celebrity revenge moments of all time, from Princess Diana to Ciara Miller. Princess Diana wore the original revenge dress to a Vanity Fair party at the Serpentine Gallery, at the same time her then-husband Prince Charles publicly admitted to cheating on her with Queen Consort Camilla Parker-Bowles. After divorcing her abusive husband Ike Turner, the late Tina Turner embraced a new era of revenge dressing, choosing bold and daring dresses like this leather cutout style from Azzedine Alaïa (pictured). Mariah Carey celebrated her emancipation from a toxic relationship with music executive Tommy Mottola with a whole new look. Free from her controlling ex-husband, she hit the red carpet circa 1998 in a hip-high-slit skirt and bra top. Shakira appeared to pay homage to the original revenge dress in her look at the 2022 Cannes Film Festival. Following news that her long-term boyfriend, Gerard Pique, was having an affair, the "TQG" singer posed in a gown with the same plunging neckline and black color as Princess Diana's look. For a modern twist, Shakira added sheer gloves, strappy sandals, and a high leg slit. While her fiancé, soccer player Sebastian Lletget, was posting a cheating admission on Instagram, Becky G was living her best life at the iHeartRadio Music Awards. She twirled in a sheer lace gown with a plunging neckline and open shoulders. The Bravo universe was shaken to its core when news dropped that "Vanderpump Rules" star Tom Sandoval cheated on fan-favorite Ariana Madix with her friend and castmate Raquel Welch. In the mid-season trailer, Madix famously told Sandoval, "[I want] for you to die," and she came to the reunion dressed to kill . The "Something About Her" co-owner wore a red-hot top and skirt from Mônot, with chest, ab, and waist cutouts on full display. Outcast Celine Mini Dress ($75) Megan Thee Stallion had a head-turning fashion moment at Miami Swim Week, backstage at her own Hot Girl Summer swimwear show. Fresh from a breakup where she revealed she'd been cheated on by NBA player Klay Thompson, she wowed in a red cutout mini that's still available to shop. Hot girl summer, indeed. Ciara Miller continues to handle the fallout from #Scamanda with elegance and grace, and her revenge look for the "Summer House" season 10 reunion is just the latest example. Wearing a bra top and low-rise maxi skirt with draping throughout, Miller's outfit made it clear that she's a force to be reckoned with and no one — least of all, a friend and ex who'd betray her for a casual hookup — will slow her down. — Additional reporting by Naomi Parris Jessica C. article_content: Taylor Swift has had many a style evolution — and fans have breathlessly followed each one. When the "Bejeweled" singer initially stepped out in boho dresses and cowboy boots, Swifties immediately began doing the same. And when she entered her preppy early-aughts-inspired era in knee socks and miniskirts, her supporters followed suit. Over the course of her nearly 20-year career, Swift's fashion has run the gamut from denim exercise dresses to sultry evening dresses and embellished bodysuits to date-night corsets . As far as inspiration, the 35-year-old star looks to a variety of muses, including preppy schoolgirls and early-aughts teens. When Swift finds her uniform of sorts, she sticks with it. And the acclaimed songwriter is famous for marrying those fashion moments to eras in her career, which also coincide with her albums — the newest of which is "The Life of A Showgirl," which came out October 3. During Swift's award-winning Eras Tour, fans recreated past aesthetics with their concert outfits . Drawing from the most iconic Swift outfits, attendees embraced the snake theme as a nod to her "Reputation" era, or gold sequins to reference her "Midnights" era . Meanwhile, Swift's own looks for star-studded events, like the VMAs or the Met Gala, are decidedly more high end. Take her Oscar de la Renta dress at the 2022 MTV VMAs , which is runway ready and glamorous, like most of Swift's red carpet outfits. It helps that the superstar loves to wear accessible brands — even when they collaborate with high-end designers. That was the case with her latest look, sitting courtside with Travis Kelce at the NBA Eastern Conference Finals. Swift's tank top was part of the highly-coveted H&M collab with Stella McCartney. While some of the collection is already sold out, there is still some inventory to sift through. article_title: Ciara Miller and the Art of Dressing for Revenge
sub_title: See all the celebrities who have worn a revenge dress through the years, from Princess Diana to Ciara Miller on "Summer House."
article_content: Princess Diana in an off-shoulder minidress when Prince Charles went public with his affair. Mariah Carey in a hip-high slit after leaving a tumultuous marriage. Ariana Madix in a fiery-red cutout set in the wake of Scandoval , when she caught her longterm boyfriend Tom Sandoval cheating with her friend Raquel Leviss. And most recently, Ciara Miller in a revenge bra and maxi skirt look to film the "Summer House" ten reunion after Scamanda , when Miller's best friend Amanda Batula secretly started dating her on-again, off-again ex-boyfriend West Wilson. The revenge look isn't a new phenomenon, but it remains at the forefront of everyone's minds. Inspired by the black mini worn by the Princess of Wales in the 1990s, the modern revenge look is fashion at its most communicative. It's bold, fitted in silhouette, and red or black or cream in color. It boasts plunging necklines and conspicuous cutouts, high splits and open backs. It's a comeback story, rendered sartorially. Despite the revenge look's enduring legacy, I always felt uneasy about it. How vengeful is a sultry outfit anyway? A better act of revenge would be, well, cheating back, as Chloe Bailey sings . What's more, the concept of "revenge dressing" frames a woman's wardrobe and appearance as her primary weapons of power. What about revenge accomplishments? Revenge art? Revenge careers? Why is it that — after a woman's been wronged — the statement that really makes an impact revolves around how she looks? I'm also not sold on the idea of dressing with the offending party in mind. Fashion is such a personal, intimate act for me; I get dressed based on my mood, my desires, my social calendar for the week. I don't want that process to be hijacked by someone else, let alone someone who caused me harm. [T]here's something empowering about the revenge dress. It speaks to the confidence of a woman who knows that her value goes far beyond how she was treated. But I learned — through experience — that there's something empowering about the revenge dress. It speaks to the confidence of a woman who knows that her value goes far beyond how she was treated. My revenge dress story is pretty typical. Several years ago, pre-pandemic, I found myself on the verge of a break up. We had been so in sync; we had amazing chemistry; we saw a future together with kids, pets, and even a few business ventures. But when I signed into his Netflix account, of all things, I saw a newly-created profile bearing another woman's name — someone he'd visited once to help her fix a broken water pipe, allegedly. I inquired about it, and our relationship quickly unraveled from there. He was belligerent and I was crushed. And the New Year's Eve party invite I had accepted a few days prior hung in the balance. I was not in the mood to dress up and be around people. But then I reconsidered; I usually enjoy a night of revelry and I refused to let him take that away from me. I landed on a dress that encapsulated that mood perfectly. A sequin micro mini with exaggerated sleeves and a plunging neckline. It was just the boost I needed to feel like myself again. It's the same energy Tina Turner emanated when she stepped out in 1986 after leaving her abusive marriage. She donned a skin-tight leather Azzedine Alaïa gown with four cutouts down the side, her hair in a blonde spiky mullet. Megan Thee Stallion had a similar air of confidence as she posed in a red Outcast cutout dress at her Hot Girl Summer Swimwear fashion show — fresh off a breakup with NBA player Klay Thompson. Dressing for revenge is less about retaliation, and more a bold declaration of self-love. It's putting on a brave face and a cutout dress or a bra and maxi skirt — and letting the world know that what happened to you didn't break you and will not define you. Keep scrolling to glean your own confidence from the best celebrity revenge moments of all time, from Princess Diana to Ciara Miller. Princess Diana wore the original revenge dress to a Vanity Fair party at the Serpentine Gallery, at the same time her then-husband Prince Charles publicly admitted to cheating on her with Queen Consort Camilla Parker-Bowles. After divorcing her abusive husband Ike Turner, the late Tina Turner embraced a new era of revenge dressing, choosing bold and daring dresses like this leather cutout style from Azzedine Alaïa (pictured). Mariah Carey celebrated her emancipation from a toxic relationship with music executive Tommy Mottola with a whole new look. Free from her controlling ex-husband, she hit the red carpet circa 1998 in a hip-high-slit skirt and bra top. Shakira appeared to pay homage to the original revenge dress in her look at the 2022 Cannes Film Festival. Following news that her long-term boyfriend, Gerard Pique, was having an affair, the "TQG" singer posed in a gown with the same plunging neckline and black color as Princess Diana's look. For a modern twist, Shakira added sheer gloves, strappy sandals, and a high leg slit. While her fiancé, soccer player Sebastian Lletget, was posting a cheating admission on Instagram, Becky G was living her best life at the iHeartRadio Music Awards. She twirled in a sheer lace gown with a plunging neckline and open shoulders. The Bravo universe was shaken to its core when news dropped that "Vanderpump Rules" star Tom Sandoval cheated on fan-favorite Ariana Madix with her friend and castmate Raquel Welch. In the mid-season trailer, Madix famously told Sandoval, "[I want] for you to die," and she came to the reunion dressed to kill . The "Something About Her" co-owner wore a red-hot top and skirt from Mônot, with chest, ab, and waist cutouts on full display. Outcast Celine Mini Dress ($75) Megan Thee Stallion had a head-turning fashion moment at Miami Swim Week, backstage at her own Hot Girl Summer swimwear show. Fresh from a breakup where she revealed she'd been cheated on by NBA player Klay Thompson, she wowed in a red cutout mini that's still available to shop. Hot girl summer, indeed. Ciara Miller continues to handle the fallout from #Scamanda with elegance and grace, and her revenge look for the "Summer House" season 10 reunion is just the latest example. Wearing a bra top and low-rise maxi skirt with draping throughout, Miller's outfit made it clear that she's a force to be reckoned with and no one — least of all, a friend and ex who'd betray her for a casual hookup — will slow her down. — Additional reporting by Naomi Parris Jessica C. article_content: Taylor Swift has had many a style evolution — and fans have breathlessly followed each one. When the "Bejeweled" singer initially stepped out in boho dresses and cowboy boots, Swifties immediately began doing the same. And when she entered her preppy early-aughts-inspired era in knee socks and miniskirts, her supporters followed suit. Over the course of her nearly 20-year career, Swift's fashion has run the gamut from denim exercise dresses to sultry evening dresses and embellished bodysuits to date-night corsets . As far as inspiration, the 35-year-old star looks to a variety of muses, including preppy schoolgirls and early-aughts teens. When Swift finds her uniform of sorts, she sticks with it. And the acclaimed songwriter is famous for marrying those fashion moments to eras in her career, which also coincide with her albums — the newest of which is "The Life of A Showgirl," which came out October 3. During Swift's award-winning Eras Tour, fans recreated past aesthetics with their concert outfits . Drawing from the most iconic Swift outfits, attendees embraced the snake theme as a nod to her "Reputation" era, or gold sequins to reference her "Midnights" era . Meanwhile, Swift's own looks for star-studded events, like the VMAs or the Met Gala, are decidedly more high end. Take her Oscar de la Renta dress at the 2022 MTV VMAs , which is runway ready and glamorous, like most of Swift's red carpet outfits. It helps that the superstar loves to wear accessible brands — even when they collaborate with high-end designers. That was the case with her latest look, sitting courtside with Travis Kelce at the NBA Eastern Conference Finals. Swift's tank top was part of the highly-coveted H&M collab with Stella McCartney. article_title: Ciara Miller and the Art of Dressing for Revenge
sub_title: See all the celebrities who have worn a revenge dress through the years, from Princess Diana to Ciara Miller on "Summer House."
article_content: Princess Diana in an off-shoulder minidress when Prince Charles went public with his affair. Mariah Carey in a hip-high slit after leaving a tumultuous marriage. Ariana Madix in a fiery-red cutout set in the wake of Scandoval , when she caught her longterm boyfriend Tom Sandoval cheating with her friend Raquel Leviss. And most recently, Ciara Miller in a revenge bra and maxi skirt look to film the "Summer House" ten reunion after Scamanda , when Miller's best friend Amanda Batula secretly started dating her on-again, off-again ex-boyfriend West Wilson. The revenge look isn't a new phenomenon, but it remains at the forefront of everyone's minds. Inspired by the black mini worn by the Princess of Wales in the 1990s, the modern revenge look is fashion at its most communicative. It's bold, fitted in silhouette, and red or black or cream in color. It boasts plunging necklines and conspicuous cutouts, high splits and open backs. It's a comeback story, rendered sartorially. Despite the revenge look's enduring legacy, I always felt uneasy about it. How vengeful is a sultry outfit anyway? A better act of revenge would be, well, cheating back, as Chloe Bailey sings . What's more, the concept of "revenge dressing" frames a woman's wardrobe and appearance as her primary weapons of power. What about revenge accomplishments? Revenge art? Revenge careers? Why is it that — after a woman's been wronged — the statement that really makes an impact revolves around how she looks? I'm also not sold on the idea of dressing with the offending party in mind. Fashion is such a personal, intimate act for me; I get dressed based on my mood, my desires, my social calendar for the week. I don't want that process to be hijacked by someone else, let alone someone who caused me harm. [T]here's something empowering about the revenge dress. It speaks to the confidence of a woman who knows that her value goes far beyond how she was treated. But I learned — through experience — that there's something empowering about the revenge dress. It speaks to the confidence of a woman who knows that her value goes far beyond how she was treated. My revenge dress story is pretty typical. Several years ago, pre-pandemic, I found myself on the verge of a break up. We had been so in sync; we had amazing chemistry; we saw a future together with kids, pets, and even a few business ventures. But when I signed into his Netflix account, of all things, I saw a newly-created profile bearing another woman's name — someone he'd visited once to help her fix a broken water pipe, allegedly. I inquired about it, and our relationship quickly unraveled from there. He was belligerent and I was crushed. And the New Year's Eve party invite I had accepted a few days prior hung in the balance. I was not in the mood to dress up and be around people. But then I reconsidered; I usually enjoy a night of revelry and I refused to let him take that away from me. I landed on a dress that encapsulated that mood perfectly. A sequin micro mini with exaggerated sleeves and a plunging neckline. It was just the boost I needed to feel like myself again. It's the same energy Tina Turner emanated when she stepped out in 1986 after leaving her abusive marriage. She donned a skin-tight leather Azzedine Alaïa gown with four cutouts down the side, her hair in a blonde spiky mullet. Megan Thee Stallion had a similar air of confidence as she posed in a red Outcast cutout dress at her Hot Girl Summer Swimwear fashion show — fresh off a breakup with NBA player Klay Thompson. Dressing for revenge is less about retaliation, and more a bold declaration of self-love. It's putting on a brave face and a cutout dress or a bra and maxi skirt — and letting the world know that what happened to you didn't break you and will not define you. Keep scrolling to glean your own confidence from the best celebrity revenge moments of all time, from Princess Diana to Ciara Miller. Princess Diana wore the original revenge dress to a Vanity Fair party at the Serpentine Gallery, at the same time her then-husband Prince Charles publicly admitted to cheating on her with Queen Consort Camilla Parker-Bowles. After divorcing her abusive husband Ike Turner, the late Tina Turner embraced a new era of revenge dressing, choosing bold and daring dresses like this leather cutout style from Azzedine Alaïa (pictured). Mariah Carey celebrated her emancipation from a toxic relationship with music executive Tommy Mottola with a whole new look. Free from her controlling ex-husband, she hit the red carpet circa 1998 in a hip-high-slit skirt and bra top. Shakira appeared to pay homage to the original revenge dress in her look at the 2022 Cannes Film Festival. Following news that her long-term boyfriend, Gerard Pique, was having an affair, the "TQG" singer posed in a gown with the same plunging neckline and black color as Princess Diana's look. For a modern twist, Shakira added sheer gloves, strappy sandals, and a high leg slit. While her fiancé, soccer player Sebastian Lletget, was posting a cheating admission on Instagram, Becky G was living her best life at the iHeartRadio Music Awards. She twirled in a sheer lace gown with a plunging neckline and open shoulders. The Bravo universe was shaken to its core when news dropped that "Vanderpump Rules" star Tom Sandoval cheated on fan-favorite Ariana Madix with her friend and castmate Raquel Welch. In the mid-season trailer, Madix famously told Sandoval, "[I want] for you to die," and she came to the reunion dressed to kill . The "Something About Her" co-owner wore a red-hot top and skirt from Mônot, with chest, ab, and waist cutouts on full display. Outcast Celine Mini Dress ($75) Megan Thee Stallion had a head-turning fashion moment at Miami Swim Week, backstage at her own Hot Girl Summer swimwear show. Fresh from a breakup where she revealed she'd been cheated on by NBA player Klay Thompson, she wowed in a red cutout mini that's still available to shop. Hot girl summer, indeed. Ciara Miller continues to handle the fallout from #Scamanda with elegance and grace, and her revenge look for the "Summer House" season 10 reunion is just the latest example. Wearing a bra top and low-rise maxi skirt with draping throughout, Miller's outfit made it clear that she's a force to be reckoned with and no one — least of all, a friend and ex who'd betray her for a casual hookup — will slow her down. — Additional reporting by Naomi Parris Jessica C. And the acclaimed songwriter is famous for marrying those fashion moments to eras in her career, which also coincide with her albums — the newest of which is "The Life of A Showgirl," which came out October 3. During Swift's award-winning Eras Tour, fans recreated past aesthetics with their concert outfits . Drawing from the most iconic Swift outfits, attendees embraced the snake theme as a nod to her "Reputation" era, or gold sequins to reference her "Midnights" era . Meanwhile, Swift's own looks for star-studded events, like the VMAs or the Met Gala, are decidedly more high end. Take her Oscar de la Renta dress at the 2022 MTV VMAs , which is runway ready and glamorous, like most of Swift's red carpet outfits. article_title: Ciara Miller and the Art of Dressing for Revenge
sub_title: See all the celebrities who have worn a revenge dress through the years, from Princess Diana to Ciara Miller on "Summer House."
article_content: Princess Diana in an off-shoulder minidress when Prince Charles went public with his affair. Mariah Carey in a hip-high slit after leaving a tumultuous marriage. Ariana Madix in a fiery-red cutout set in the wake of Scandoval , when she caught her longterm boyfriend Tom Sandoval cheating with her friend Raquel Leviss. And most recently, Ciara Miller in a revenge bra and maxi skirt look to film the "Summer House" ten reunion after Scamanda , when Miller's best friend Amanda Batula secretly started dating her on-again, off-again ex-boyfriend West Wilson. The revenge look isn't a new phenomenon, but it remains at the forefront of everyone's minds. Inspired by the black mini worn by the Princess of Wales in the 1990s, the modern revenge look is fashion at its most communicative. It's bold, fitted in silhouette, and red or black or cream in color. It boasts plunging necklines and conspicuous cutouts, high splits and open backs. It's a comeback story, rendered sartorially. Despite the revenge look's enduring legacy, I always felt uneasy about it. How vengeful is a sultry outfit anyway? A better act of revenge would be, well, cheating back, as Chloe Bailey sings . What's more, the concept of "revenge dressing" frames a woman's wardrobe and appearance as her primary weapons of power. What about revenge accomplishments? Revenge art? Revenge careers? Why is it that — after a woman's been wronged — the statement that really makes an impact revolves around how she looks? I'm also not sold on the idea of dressing with the offending party in mind. Fashion is such a personal, intimate act for me; I get dressed based on my mood, my desires, my social calendar for the week. I don't want that process to be hijacked by someone else, let alone someone who caused me harm. [T]here's something empowering about the revenge dress. It speaks to the confidence of a woman who knows that her value goes far beyond how she was treated. But I learned — through experience — that there's something empowering about the revenge dress. It speaks to the confidence of a woman who knows that her value goes far beyond how she was treated. My revenge dress story is pretty typical. Several years ago, pre-pandemic, I found myself on the verge of a break up. We had been so in sync; we had amazing chemistry; we saw a future together with kids, pets, and even a few business ventures. But when I signed into his Netflix account, of all things, I saw a newly-created profile bearing another woman's name — someone he'd visited once to help her fix a broken water pipe, allegedly. I inquired about it, and our relationship quickly unraveled from there. He was belligerent and I was crushed. And the New Year's Eve party invite I had accepted a few days prior hung in the balance. I was not in the mood to dress up and be around people. But then I reconsidered; I usually enjoy a night of revelry and I refused to let him take that away from me. I landed on a dress that encapsulated that mood perfectly. A sequin micro mini with exaggerated sleeves and a plunging neckline. It was just the boost I needed to feel like myself again. It's the same energy Tina Turner emanated when she stepped out in 1986 after leaving her abusive marriage. She donned a skin-tight leather Azzedine Alaïa gown with four cutouts down the side, her hair in a blonde spiky mullet. Megan Thee Stallion had a similar air of confidence as she posed in a red Outcast cutout dress at her Hot Girl Summer Swimwear fashion show — fresh off a breakup with NBA player Klay Thompson. Dressing for revenge is less about retaliation, and more a bold declaration of self-love. It's putting on a brave face and a cutout dress or a bra and maxi skirt — and letting the world know that what happened to you didn't break you and will not define you. Keep scrolling to glean your own confidence from the best celebrity revenge moments of all time, from Princess Diana to Ciara Miller. Princess Diana wore the original revenge dress to a Vanity Fair party at the Serpentine Gallery, at the same time her then-husband Prince Charles publicly admitted to cheating on her with Queen Consort Camilla Parker-Bowles. After divorcing her abusive husband Ike Turner, the late Tina Turner embraced a new era of revenge dressing, choosing bold and daring dresses like this leather cutout style from Azzedine Alaïa (pictured). Mariah Carey celebrated her emancipation from a toxic relationship with music executive Tommy Mottola with a whole new look. Free from her controlling ex-husband, she hit the red carpet circa 1998 in a hip-high-slit skirt and bra top. Shakira appeared to pay homage to the original revenge dress in her look at the 2022 Cannes Film Festival. Following news that her long-term boyfriend, Gerard Pique, was having an affair, the "TQG" singer posed in a gown with the same plunging neckline and black color as Princess Diana's look. For a modern twist, Shakira added sheer gloves, strappy sandals, and a high leg slit. While her fiancé, soccer player Sebastian Lletget, was posting a cheating admission on Instagram, Becky G was living her best life at the iHeartRadio Music Awards. She twirled in a sheer lace gown with a plunging neckline and open shoulders. The Bravo universe was shaken to its core when news dropped that "Vanderpump Rules" star Tom Sandoval cheated on fan-favorite Ariana Madix with her friend and castmate Raquel Welch. In the mid-season trailer, Madix famously told Sandoval, "[I want] for you to die," and she came to the reunion dressed to kill . The "Something About Her" co-owner wore a red-hot top and skirt from Mônot, with chest, ab, and waist cutouts on full display. Outcast Celine Mini Dress ($75) Megan Thee Stallion had a head-turning fashion moment at Miami Swim Week, backstage at her own Hot Girl Summer swimwear show. Fresh from a breakup where she revealed she'd been cheated on by NBA player Klay Thompson, she wowed in a red cutout mini that's still available to shop. Hot girl summer, indeed. Ciara Miller continues to handle the fallout from #Scamanda with elegance and grace, and her revenge look for the "Summer House" season 10 reunion is just the latest example. Wearing a bra top and low-rise maxi skirt with draping throughout, Miller's outfit made it clear that she's a force to be reckoned with and no one — least of all, a friend and ex who'd betray her for a casual hookup — will slow her down. — Additional reporting by Naomi Parris Jessica C. article_content: Taylor Swift has had many a style evolution — and fans have breathlessly followed each one. When the "Bejeweled" singer initially stepped out in boho dresses and cowboy boots, Swifties immediately began doing the same. And when she entered her preppy early-aughts-inspired era in knee socks and miniskirts, her supporters followed suit. Over the course of her nearly 20-year career, Swift's fashion has run the gamut from denim exercise dresses to sultry evening dresses and embellished bodysuits to date-night corsets . As far as inspiration, the 35-year-old star looks to a variety of muses, including preppy schoolgirls and early-aughts teens. When Swift finds her uniform of sorts, she sticks with it. And the acclaimed songwriter is famous for marrying those fashion moments to eras in her career, which also coincide with her albums — the newest of which is "The Life of A Showgirl," which came out October 3. During Swift's award-winning Eras Tour, fans recreated past aesthetics with their concert outfits . Drawing from the most iconic Swift outfits, attendees embraced the snake theme as a nod to her "Reputation" era, or gold sequins to reference her "Midnights" era . Meanwhile, Swift's own looks for star-studded events, like the VMAs or the Met Gala, are decidedly more high end. Take her Oscar de la Renta dress at the 2022 MTV VMAs , which is runway ready and glamorous, like most of Swift's red carpet outfits. It helps that the superstar loves to wear accessible brands — even when they collaborate with high-end designers. That was the case with her latest look, sitting courtside with Travis Kelce at the NBA Eastern Conference Finals. Swift's tank top was part of the highly-coveted H&M collab with Stella McCartney. article_title: Ciara Miller and the Art of Dressing for Revenge
sub_title: See all the celebrities who have worn a revenge dress through the years, from Princess Diana to Ciara Miller on "Summer House."
article_content: Princess Diana in an off-shoulder minidress when Prince Charles went public with his affair. Mariah Carey in a hip-high slit after leaving a tumultuous marriage. Ariana Madix in a fiery-red cutout set in the wake of Scandoval , when she caught her longterm boyfriend Tom Sandoval cheating with her friend Raquel Leviss. And most recently, Ciara Miller in a revenge bra and maxi skirt look to film the "Summer House" ten reunion after Scamanda , when Miller's best friend Amanda Batula secretly started dating her on-again, off-again ex-boyfriend West Wilson. The revenge look isn't a new phenomenon, but it remains at the forefront of everyone's minds. Inspired by the black mini worn by the Princess of Wales in the 1990s, the modern revenge look is fashion at its most communicative. It's bold, fitted in silhouette, and red or black or cream in color. It boasts plunging necklines and conspicuous cutouts, high splits and open backs. It's a comeback story, rendered sartorially. Despite the revenge look's enduring legacy, I always felt uneasy about it. How vengeful is a sultry outfit anyway? A better act of revenge would be, well, cheating back, as Chloe Bailey sings . What's more, the concept of "revenge dressing" frames a woman's wardrobe and appearance as her primary weapons of power. What about revenge accomplishments? Revenge art? Revenge careers? Why is it that — after a woman's been wronged — the statement that really makes an impact revolves around how she looks? I'm also not sold on the idea of dressing with the offending party in mind. Fashion is such a personal, intimate act for me; I get dressed based on my mood, my desires, my social calendar for the week. I don't want that process to be hijacked by someone else, let alone someone who caused me harm. [T]here's something empowering about the revenge dress. It speaks to the confidence of a woman who knows that her value goes far beyond how she was treated. But I learned — through experience — that there's something empowering about the revenge dress. It speaks to the confidence of a woman who knows that her value goes far beyond how she was treated. My revenge dress story is pretty typical. Several years ago, pre-pandemic, I found myself on the verge of a break up. We had been so in sync; we had amazing chemistry; we saw a future together with kids, pets, and even a few business ventures. But when I signed into his Netflix account, of all things, I saw a newly-created profile bearing another woman's name — someone he'd visited once to help her fix a broken water pipe, allegedly. I inquired about it, and our relationship quickly unraveled from there. He was belligerent and I was crushed. And the New Year's Eve party invite I had accepted a few days prior hung in the balance. I was not in the mood to dress up and be around people. But then I reconsidered; I usually enjoy a night of revelry and I refused to let him take that away from me. I landed on a dress that encapsulated that mood perfectly. A sequin micro mini with exaggerated sleeves and a plunging neckline. It was just the boost I needed to feel like myself again. It's the same energy Tina Turner emanated when she stepped out in 1986 after leaving her abusive marriage. She donned a skin-tight leather Azzedine Alaïa gown with four cutouts down the side, her hair in a blonde spiky mullet. Megan Thee Stallion had a similar air of confidence as she posed in a red Outcast cutout dress at her Hot Girl Summer Swimwear fashion show — fresh off a breakup with NBA player Klay Thompson. Dressing for revenge is less about retaliation, and more a bold declaration of self-love. It's putting on a brave face and a cutout dress or a bra and maxi skirt — and letting the world know that what happened to you didn't break you and will not define you. Keep scrolling to glean your own confidence from the best celebrity revenge moments of all time, from Princess Diana to Ciara Miller. Princess Diana wore the original revenge dress to a Vanity Fair party at the Serpentine Gallery, at the same time her then-husband Prince Charles publicly admitted to cheating on her with Queen Consort Camilla Parker-Bowles. After divorcing her abusive husband Ike Turner, the late Tina Turner embraced a new era of revenge dressing, choosing bold and daring dresses like this leather cutout style from Azzedine Alaïa (pictured). Mariah Carey celebrated her emancipation from a toxic relationship with music executive Tommy Mottola with a whole new look. Free from her controlling ex-husband, she hit the red carpet circa 1998 in a hip-high-slit skirt and bra top. Shakira appeared to pay homage to the original revenge dress in her look at the 2022 Cannes Film Festival. Following news that her long-term boyfriend, Gerard Pique, was having an affair, the "TQG" singer posed in a gown with the same plunging neckline and black color as Princess Diana's look. For a modern twist, Shakira added sheer gloves, strappy sandals, and a high leg slit. While her fiancé, soccer player Sebastian Lletget, was posting a cheating admission on Instagram, Becky G was living her best life at the iHeartRadio Music Awards. She twirled in a sheer lace gown with a plunging neckline and open shoulders. The Bravo universe was shaken to its core when news dropped that "Vanderpump Rules" star Tom Sandoval cheated on fan-favorite Ariana Madix with her friend and castmate Raquel Welch. In the mid-season trailer, Madix famously told Sandoval, "[I want] for you to die," and she came to the reunion dressed to kill . The "Something About Her" co-owner wore a red-hot top and skirt from Mônot, with chest, ab, and waist cutouts on full display. Outcast Celine Mini Dress ($75) Megan Thee Stallion had a head-turning fashion moment at Miami Swim Week, backstage at her own Hot Girl Summer swimwear show. Fresh from a breakup where she revealed she'd been cheated on by NBA player Klay Thompson, she wowed in a red cutout mini that's still available to shop. Hot girl summer, indeed. Ciara Miller continues to handle the fallout from #Scamanda with elegance and grace, and her revenge look for the "Summer House" season 10 reunion is just the latest example. Wearing a bra top and low-rise maxi skirt with draping throughout, Miller's outfit made it clear that she's a force to be reckoned with and no one — least of all, a friend and ex who'd betray her for a casual hookup — will slow her down. — Additional reporting by Naomi Parris Jessica C. article_content: Taylor Swift has had many a style evolution — and fans have breathlessly followed each one. When the "Bejeweled" singer initially stepped out in boho dresses and cowboy boots, Swifties immediately began doing the same. And when she entered her preppy early-aughts-inspired era in knee socks and miniskirts, her supporters followed suit. Over the course of her nearly 20-year career, Swift's fashion has run the gamut from denim exercise dresses to sultry evening dresses and embellished bodysuits to date-night corsets . As far as inspiration, the 35-year-old star looks to a variety of muses, including preppy schoolgirls and early-aughts teens. When Swift finds her uniform of sorts, she sticks with it. And the acclaimed songwriter is famous for marrying those fashion moments to eras in her career, which also coincide with her albums — the newest of which is "The Life of A Showgirl," which came out October 3.
