article_title: Ciara Miller and the Art of Dressing for Revenge
sub_title: See all the celebrities who have worn a revenge dress through the years, from Princess Diana to Ciara Miller on "Summer House."
article_content: Princess Diana in an off-shoulder minidress when Prince Charles went public with his affair. Mariah Carey in a hip-high slit after leaving a tumultuous marriage. Ariana Madix in a fiery-red cutout set in the wake of Scandoval , when she caught her longterm boyfriend Tom Sandoval cheating with her friend Raquel Leviss. And most recently, Ciara Miller in a revenge bra and maxi skirt look to film the "Summer House" ten reunion after Scamanda , when Miller's best friend Amanda Batula secretly started dating her on-again, off-again ex-boyfriend West Wilson. The revenge look isn't a new phenomenon, but it remains at the forefront of everyone's minds. Inspired by the black mini worn by the Princess of Wales in the 1990s, the modern revenge look is fashion at its most communicative. It's bold, fitted in silhouette, and red or black or cream in color. It boasts plunging necklines and conspicuous cutouts, high splits and open backs. It's a comeback story, rendered sartorially. Despite the revenge look's enduring legacy, I always felt uneasy about it. How vengeful is a sultry outfit anyway? A better act of revenge would be, well, cheating back, as Chloe Bailey sings . What's more, the concept of "revenge dressing" frames a woman's wardrobe and appearance as her primary weapons of power. What about revenge accomplishments? Revenge art? Revenge careers? Why is it that — after a woman's been wronged — the statement that really makes an impact revolves around how she looks? I'm also not sold on the idea of dressing with the offending party in mind. Fashion is such a personal, intimate act for me; I get dressed based on my mood, my desires, my social calendar for the week. I don't want that process to be hijacked by someone else, let alone someone who caused me harm. [T]here's something empowering about the revenge dress. It speaks to the confidence of a woman who knows that her value goes far beyond how she was treated. But I learned — through experience — that there's something empowering about the revenge dress. It speaks to the confidence of a woman who knows that her value goes far beyond how she was treated. My revenge dress story is pretty typical. Several years ago, pre-pandemic, I found myself on the verge of a break up. We had been so in sync; we had amazing chemistry; we saw a future together with kids, pets, and even a few business ventures. But when I signed into his Netflix account, of all things, I saw a newly-created profile bearing another woman's name — someone he'd visited once to help her fix a broken water pipe, allegedly. I inquired about it, and our relationship quickly unraveled from there. He was belligerent and I was crushed. And the New Year's Eve party invite I had accepted a few days prior hung in the balance. I was not in the mood to dress up and be around people. But then I reconsidered; I usually enjoy a night of revelry and I refused to let him take that away from me. I landed on a dress that encapsulated that mood perfectly. A sequin micro mini with exaggerated sleeves and a plunging neckline. It was just the boost I needed to feel like myself again. It's the same energy Tina Turner emanated when she stepped out in 1986 after leaving her abusive marriage. She donned a skin-tight leather Azzedine Alaïa gown with four cutouts down the side, her hair in a blonde spiky mullet. Megan Thee Stallion had a similar air of confidence as she posed in a red Outcast cutout dress at her Hot Girl Summer Swimwear fashion show — fresh off a breakup with NBA player Klay Thompson. Dressing for revenge is less about retaliation, and more a bold declaration of self-love. It's putting on a brave face and a cutout dress or a bra and maxi skirt — and letting the world know that what happened to you didn't break you and will not define you. Keep scrolling to glean your own confidence from the best celebrity revenge moments of all time, from Princess Diana to Ciara Miller. Princess Diana wore the original revenge dress to a Vanity Fair party at the Serpentine Gallery, at the same time her then-husband Prince Charles publicly admitted to cheating on her with Queen Consort Camilla Parker-Bowles. After divorcing her abusive husband Ike Turner, the late Tina Turner embraced a new era of revenge dressing, choosing bold and daring dresses like this leather cutout style from Azzedine Alaïa (pictured). Mariah Carey celebrated her emancipation from a toxic relationship with music executive Tommy Mottola with a whole new look. Free from her controlling ex-husband, she hit the red carpet circa 1998 in a hip-high-slit skirt and bra top. Shakira appeared to pay homage to the original revenge dress in her look at the 2022 Cannes Film Festival. Following news that her long-term boyfriend, Gerard Pique, was having an affair, the "TQG" singer posed in a gown with the same plunging neckline and black color as Princess Diana's look. For a modern twist, Shakira added sheer gloves, strappy sandals, and a high leg slit. While her fiancé, soccer player Sebastian Lletget, was posting a cheating admission on Instagram, Becky G was living her best life at the iHeartRadio Music Awards. She twirled in a sheer lace gown with a plunging neckline and open shoulders. The Bravo universe was shaken to its core when news dropped that "Vanderpump Rules" star Tom Sandoval cheated on fan-favorite Ariana Madix with her friend and castmate Raquel Welch. In the mid-season trailer, Madix famously told Sandoval, "[I want] for you to die," and she came to the reunion dressed to kill . The "Something About Her" co-owner wore a red-hot top and skirt from Mônot, with chest, ab, and waist cutouts on full display. Fresh from a breakup where she revealed she'd been cheated on by NBA player Klay Thompson, she wowed in a red cutout mini that's still available to shop. Hot girl summer, indeed. Ciara Miller continues to handle the fallout from #Scamanda with elegance and grace, and her revenge look for the "Summer House" season 10 reunion is just the latest example. Wearing a bra top and low-rise maxi skirt with draping throughout, Miller's outfit made it clear that she's a force to be reckoned with and no one — least of all, a friend and ex who'd betray her for a casual hookup — will slow her down. — Additional reporting by Naomi Parris Jessica C. article_title: Ciara Miller and the Art of Dressing for Revenge
sub_title: See all the celebrities who have worn a revenge dress through the years, from Princess Diana to Ciara Miller on "Summer House."
article_content: Princess Diana in an off-shoulder minidress when Prince Charles went public with his affair. Mariah Carey in a hip-high slit after leaving a tumultuous marriage. Ariana Madix in a fiery-red cutout set in the wake of Scandoval , when she caught her longterm boyfriend Tom Sandoval cheating with her friend Raquel Leviss. And most recently, Ciara Miller in a revenge bra and maxi skirt look to film the "Summer House" ten reunion after Scamanda , when Miller's best friend Amanda Batula secretly started dating her on-again, off-again ex-boyfriend West Wilson. The revenge look isn't a new phenomenon, but it remains at the forefront of everyone's minds. Inspired by the black mini worn by the Princess of Wales in the 1990s, the modern revenge look is fashion at its most communicative. It's bold, fitted in silhouette, and red or black or cream in color. It boasts plunging necklines and conspicuous cutouts, high splits and open backs. It's a comeback story, rendered sartorially. Despite the revenge look's enduring legacy, I always felt uneasy about it. How vengeful is a sultry outfit anyway? A better act of revenge would be, well, cheating back, as Chloe Bailey sings . What's more, the concept of "revenge dressing" frames a woman's wardrobe and appearance as her primary weapons of power. What about revenge accomplishments? Revenge art? Revenge careers? Why is it that — after a woman's been wronged — the statement that really makes an impact revolves around how she looks? I'm also not sold on the idea of dressing with the offending party in mind. Fashion is such a personal, intimate act for me; I get dressed based on my mood, my desires, my social calendar for the week. I don't want that process to be hijacked by someone else, let alone someone who caused me harm. [T]here's something empowering about the revenge dress. It speaks to the confidence of a woman who knows that her value goes far beyond how she was treated. But I learned — through experience — that there's something empowering about the revenge dress. It speaks to the confidence of a woman who knows that her value goes far beyond how she was treated. My revenge dress story is pretty typical. Several years ago, pre-pandemic, I found myself on the verge of a break up. We had been so in sync; we had amazing chemistry; we saw a future together with kids, pets, and even a few business ventures. But when I signed into his Netflix account, of all things, I saw a newly-created profile bearing another woman's name — someone he'd visited once to help her fix a broken water pipe, allegedly. I inquired about it, and our relationship quickly unraveled from there. He was belligerent and I was crushed. And the New Year's Eve party invite I had accepted a few days prior hung in the balance. I was not in the mood to dress up and be around people. But then I reconsidered; I usually enjoy a night of revelry and I refused to let him take that away from me. I landed on a dress that encapsulated that mood perfectly. A sequin micro mini with exaggerated sleeves and a plunging neckline. It was just the boost I needed to feel like myself again. It's the same energy Tina Turner emanated when she stepped out in 1986 after leaving her abusive marriage. She donned a skin-tight leather Azzedine Alaïa gown with four cutouts down the side, her hair in a blonde spiky mullet. Megan Thee Stallion had a similar air of confidence as she posed in a red Outcast cutout dress at her Hot Girl Summer Swimwear fashion show — fresh off a breakup with NBA player Klay Thompson. Dressing for revenge is less about retaliation, and more a bold declaration of self-love. It's putting on a brave face and a cutout dress or a bra and maxi skirt — and letting the world know that what happened to you didn't break you and will not define you. Keep scrolling to glean your own confidence from the best celebrity revenge moments of all time, from Princess Diana to Ciara Miller. Princess Diana wore the original revenge dress to a Vanity Fair party at the Serpentine Gallery, at the same time her then-husband Prince Charles publicly admitted to cheating on her with Queen Consort Camilla Parker-Bowles. After divorcing her abusive husband Ike Turner, the late Tina Turner embraced a new era of revenge dressing, choosing bold and daring dresses like this leather cutout style from Azzedine Alaïa (pictured). Mariah Carey celebrated her emancipation from a toxic relationship with music executive Tommy Mottola with a whole new look. Free from her controlling ex-husband, she hit the red carpet circa 1998 in a hip-high-slit skirt and bra top. Shakira appeared to pay homage to the original revenge dress in her look at the 2022 Cannes Film Festival. Following news that her long-term boyfriend, Gerard Pique, was having an affair, the "TQG" singer posed in a gown with the same plunging neckline and black color as Princess Diana's look. For a modern twist, Shakira added sheer gloves, strappy sandals, and a high leg slit. While her fiancé, soccer player Sebastian Lletget, was posting a cheating admission on Instagram, Becky G was living her best life at the iHeartRadio Music Awards. She twirled in a sheer lace gown with a plunging neckline and open shoulders. The Bravo universe was shaken to its core when news dropped that "Vanderpump Rules" star Tom Sandoval cheated on fan-favorite Ariana Madix with her friend and castmate Raquel Welch. In the mid-season trailer, Madix famously told Sandoval, "[I want] for you to die," and she came to the reunion dressed to kill . The "Something About Her" co-owner wore a red-hot top and skirt from Mônot, with chest, ab, and waist cutouts on full display. Outcast Celine Mini Dress ($75) Megan Thee Stallion had a head-turning fashion moment at Miami Swim Week, backstage at her own Hot Girl Summer swimwear show. Fresh from a breakup where she revealed she'd been cheated on by NBA player Klay Thompson, she wowed in a red cutout mini that's still available to shop. Hot girl summer, indeed. Ciara Miller continues to handle the fallout from #Scamanda with elegance and grace, and her revenge look for the "Summer House" season 10 reunion is just the latest example. Wearing a bra top and low-rise maxi skirt with draping throughout, Miller's outfit made it clear that she's a force to be reckoned with and no one — least of all, a friend and ex who'd betray her for a casual hookup — will slow her down. — Additional reporting by Naomi Parris Jessica C. During Swift's award-winning Eras Tour, fans recreated past aesthetics with their concert outfits . Meanwhile, Swift's own looks for star-studded events, like the VMAs or the Met Gala, are decidedly more high end. Take her Oscar de la Renta dress at the 2022 MTV VMAs , which is runway ready and glamorous, like most of Swift's red carpet outfits. If you're looking for something similar to the sold-out top , these styles capture the same aesthetic: The Noli Shop Millie Knit Tank ($128); All Saints Lucy Tank Top ($129); Generation Love Mabel Chain Trim Top ($148); and Forever 21 Plus Size Seamless Chain-Trim Tank ($11, originally $20). The only item from Swift's all-black outfit that wasn't Louis Vuitton on date-night with fiancé Travis Kelce? Her Fleur du Mal rose lace tights. With the addition of some gold jewelry courtesy of Cartier, 100 Ways, and, of course, her engagement ring , the stockings brought texture and dimension to an otherwise chic and neutral look. Swift's black off-shoulder bodysuit from Alaïa, worn on Nov. 11 in New York City, features subtle ribbing and a snap-button closure. She teamed it with gray Stella McCartney wool slacks, Jimmy Choo x Jean Paul Gaultier pumps, the Stella McCartney Ryder bag, and jewelry, including her engagement ring and complementary pieces from Louis Vuitton and Audry Rose. While the outfit costs a pretty penny, Swift has proven a black sculpting bodysuit is a timeless staple, having worn a similar style with a plaid miniskirt exactly one year prior. Taylor Swift steps out in NYC in the perfect preppy Autumn outfit, wearing a Stella McCartney polo shirt and knee-high boots from Prada. Taylor Swift nods to the release of "1989 (Taylor's Version)" with Fall colors: a brown Acne Studios corduroy skirt, Madewell leather blazer, and Gianvito Rossi ankle boots. Taylor Swift wowed at "Taylor Swift: The Eras Tour" concert movie world premiere in a strapless cutout gown from Oscar de la Renta. She complemented the look with strappy sandals, a curly bob, and her signature red lip. At the 2023 Grammy Awards, Taylor Swift hit the red carpet in a navy crop top and skirt designed by Roberto Cavalli and oversize statement earrings and rings from Lorraine Schwartz. Taylor Swift rocked a take on the naked dress at the 2022 MTV VMAs in an Oscar de la Renta chain-link minidress that was totally sheer, save for the allover embellishment. Her jewelry was by Lorraine Schwartz, and her heels were from Christian Louboutin. Taylor Swift borrowed from the boys with a Max Mara suiting look in NYC in June 2022, choosing to wear a waistcoat with nothing underneath. She wore it with Vrai earrings and rings, along with Prada pumps. For the 2021 Grammy Awards, Swift went for a spring theme, slipping into a gorgeous embroidered floral dress from Oscar de la Renta. She paired the look with pink ankle-tie heels from Christian Louboutin and Cathy Waterman jewelry. Taylor Swift channeled a disco ball at the 2018 AMAs, dressed head to toe in Balmain with a metallic minidress and thigh-high boots, styled with Lorraine Schwartz jewelry. Taylor Swift's summertime take on the Canadian tuxedo consisted of a Madewell denim crop top and black denim Ksubi shorts. She kept it casual with a pair of white sneakers from Golden Goose, Jimmy Choo sunglasses, and a Christian Louboutin backpack slung over one shoulder. Going for a futuristic look for the Met Gala that she hosted in 2016, Swift slipped into a cutout metallic minidress from Louis Vuitton with black heels that crisscrossed their way all the way to her knees. Her jewelry was designed by Eva Fehren, Massia Cielo, and Borgioni. Taylor Swift went for full-blown color at the 2016 Grammy Awards, dressed in a Versace crop top and high-waisted ball skirt with an up-to-there slit that showed off the built-in briefs underneath. On one hand were two rings from Ofira, while the rest of her jewelry was designed by Lorraine Schwartz. Taking her white kitten for a stroll in NYC, Swift went for a schoolgirl-inspired look, slipping into a plaid miniskirt from RD Style, a white top from Free People, crocheted knee socks from Tabbisocks, and pumps from & Other Stories. Taylor Swift loves a matching set, and she rocked a sheer striped floral miniskirt and cropped tee from H&M with Elie Saab heels in New York City in August 2014. Taylor Swift was ladylike with a twist while in New York City in July 2017, wearing a polka-dot slit pencil skirt and matching crop top, both from Reformation. On her feet were Pikolinos heels, and she carried a bag from Kate Spade. article_content: The Met Gala 2026 red carpet was a parade of unforgettable looks , from Kendall Jenner's GapStudio dress inspired by a white T-shirt to Janelle Monáe's Christian Siriano gown with animatronic butterflies and live wires. Plus, we can't forget the beauty moments that made our jaws drop (like Tyla's peacock-inspired nails and Bad Bunny's intricate prosthetics ) — many of which can be recreated with affordable drugstore products that celebrities actually used. And while most stars met the moment by bringing the "Fashion Is Art" theme to life, a few went a step further to incorporate art specific to their culture in their looks as well. All that to say, the night wasn't lacking when it came to sartorial inspiration. The one challenge? Not many celebrity looks were accessible or available to shop ( Meta Watch party street style notwithstanding). Lisa, however, was a welcome exception. The global star and " White Lotus " actress was one of the few who hit the after party circuit in a look we can't wait to recreate. Stepping out of the Mark Hotel on May 4, Lisa donned the Intimissimi Emma Refined Everyday Bralette Triangle Bra in White Silk, choosing to style it as a bra top. She finished her look with a sleek suit, a Louis Vuitton handbag, and a fur stole. The lingerie trend is nothing new, with bra tops continuing to dominate everything from party outfits to festival fashion . It's notable though that Lisa elevates the look by mixing different textures in the same neutral color scheme, adding interest while maintaining a sense of elegance and polish. This year, Coachella welcomed performers like Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, and Karol G, who made history as the first Latina headliner . What's more, a star-studded crowd showed up at soirées outside festival grounds, including the Revolve Festival, Nylon House, and more.
